CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.faceTris_range.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {b : β} {f : α → β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.map f l) = ∃ a ∈ l, f a = b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.faceTris_tri.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.faceTris_tri
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.faceTris_tri.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (c : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin c.kind.n),
  a0 ≠ a1 →
    a0 ≠ a2 →
      a1 ≠ a2 →
        (({c.glob a0, c.glob a1, c.glob a2}, false) ∈ c.faceTris ↔
          CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.triAny c.kind a0 a1 a2 = true)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] (W : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3) (p : C × Fin 4),
  (W.simplex p.1).Nondeg →
    ∀ (i0 i1 i2 : ι),
      i0 ≠ i1 →
        i0 ≠ i2 →
          i1 ≠ i2 →
            W.facetNodes p = {i0, i1, i2} →
              W.facetVec p =
                (-(1 / 2) *
                    CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (W.pos i0) (W.pos i1) (W.pos i2) (W.pos ((W.vert p.1) p.2)))) •
                  CFDLean.Num.cross3 (W.pos i1 - W.pos i0) (W.pos i2 - W.pos i0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α ↪ β} {s : Finset α} {b : β}, (b ∈ Finset.map f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {s : Finset α}, (a ∈ s.erase b) = (a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._simp_1_4
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._simp_1_5
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.facetVec_any._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF.type: {n : ℕ} → Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → Bool

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF.eq_1.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (a0 a1 a2 v : Fin n), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF a0 a1 a2 v = (v == a0 || v == a1 || v == a2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.localOK.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.localOK.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.localOK.eq_1.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.localOK k =
    (List.finRange k.n).all fun a0 =>
      (List.finRange k.n).all fun a1 =>
        (List.finRange k.n).all fun a2 =>
          a0 == a1 || a0 == a2 || a1 == a2 ||
            !(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny k a0 a1 a2 && CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.triAny k a0 a1 a2) &&
              2 * (List.map (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ k a0 a1 a2) k.tets).sum ==
                CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shareZ k a0 a1 a2 * (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.cenZ k a0 a1 a2).sign

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin k.n),
  a0 ≠ a1 →
    a0 ≠ a2 →
      a1 ≠ a2 →
        ¬(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny k a0 a1 a2 = true ∧ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.triAny k a0 a1 a2 = true) ∧
          2 * (List.map (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ k a0 a1 a2) k.tets).sum =
            CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shareZ k a0 a1 a2 * (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.cenZ k a0 a1 a2).sign

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {l : List α}, (l.all p = true) = ∀ x ∈ l, p x = true

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n), (x ∈ List.finRange n) = True

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp_1_4
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.type: ∀ {b : Prop} (α : Sort u_1) [i : Nonempty α], (∀ (a : α), b) = b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp_1_5
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a b : α}, ((a == b) = true) = (a = b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp_1_6
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok._simp.type: ∀ {x y : Bool}, ((x && y) = false) = (x = true → y = false)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok.match.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok.match_1_7
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.local_ok.match.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin k.n)
  (motive :
    CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny k a0 a1 a2 = true ∧ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.triAny k a0 a1 a2 = true → Prop)
  (x : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny k a0 a1 a2 = true ∧ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.triAny k a0 a1 a2 = true),
  (∀ (hq : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny k a0 a1 a2 = true)
      (ht : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.triAny k a0 a1 a2 = true), motive ⋯) →
    motive x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (g : Fin n ↪ ι) (t : List (Fin n)) (z : Fin n),
  t.length = 4 →
    t.Nodup →
      ∀ (e : Fin 4 ↪ ι),
        (∀ (a : Fin 4), e a = g (t.getD (↑a) z)) →
          ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : Fin n),
            a0 ≠ a1 →
              a0 ≠ a2 →
                a1 ≠ a2 →
                  ∀ (o : Fin 4),
                    Finset.map e (Finset.univ.erase o) = {g a0, g a1, g a2} ↔
                      (t.contains a0 && t.contains a1 && t.contains a2) = true ∧
                        CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF a0 a1 a2 (t.getD (↑o) z) = false

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._pro.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._proof_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._pro.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (t : List (Fin n)), t.length = 4 → ∀ i < t.length, ¬i < 4 → False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._pro.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._proof_1_12
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._pro.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (g : Fin n ↪ ι) (t : List (Fin n)) (e : Fin 4 ↪ ι) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin n)
  (o : Fin 4),
  {g a0, g a1, g a2}.card = 3 →
    (Finset.map e (Finset.univ.erase o)).card = 3 →
      ¬(Finset.map e (Finset.univ.erase o)).card ≤ {g a0, g a1, g a2}.card → False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._pro.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._proof_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._pro.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (t : List (Fin n)), t.length = 4 → ∀ (a : Fin 4), ¬↑a < t.length → False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_10
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α ↪ β} {s : Finset α} {b : β}, (b ∈ Finset.map f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_4
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {s : Finset α}, (a ∈ s.erase b) = (a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_5
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_6
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {as : List α}, (as.contains a = true) = (a ∈ as)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_8
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {x y : Bool}, ((x || y) = false) = (x = false ∧ y = false)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._simp_1_9
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.match_iff._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a b : α}, ((a == b) = false) = (a ≠ b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_f.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_false
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_f.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_f.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → List β} {b : β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.flatMap f l) = ∃ a ∈ l, b ∈ f a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_t.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_true
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_t.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (c : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι) (S : Finset ι),
  (S, true) ∈ c.faceTris ↔ ∃ f ∈ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris c.kind.cell, (List.map (⇑c.glob) f).toFinset = S

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_t.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_true._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.mem_faceTris_t.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → List β} {b : β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.flatMap f l) = ∃ a ∈ l, b ∈ f a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (c : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι) (S : Finset ι),
  (S, true) ∈ c.faceTris → (S, false) ∈ c.faceTris → False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.not_both._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny.type: (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) → Fin k.n → Fin k.n → Fin k.n → Bool

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny.eq_1.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin k.n),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadAny k a0 a1 a2 =
    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris k.cell).any fun f => f.contains a0 && f.contains a1 && f.contains a2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris.eq_1.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (C : CFDLean.JST1.RefCell.Cell3 n),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris C = List.flatMap (fun q => q.tris false ++ q.tris true) C.quads

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ.match_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ.match_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ.match_1.type:
(motive : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind → Sort u_1) →
  (x : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) →
    (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind.hex) →
      (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind.prism) → (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind.pyr) → motive x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.ref_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.ref_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.ref_eq.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (a : Fin k.n),
  k.ref a = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF.type: (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) → List (Fin k.n) → Fin k.n → ℤ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF.eq_1.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (f : List (Fin k.n)) (v : Fin k.n),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF k f v =
    CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k (f.getD 0 (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)))
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k (f.getD 1 (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)))
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k (f.getD 2 (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k))) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k v)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg_mul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg_mul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg_mul.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg (x * y) = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg x * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg y

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg_opp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg_opp
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg_opp.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), x * y < 0 → CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg x + CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg y = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind),
  (∀ t ∈ k.tets, t.length = 4 ∧ t.Nodup) ∧
    (∀ f ∈ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris k.cell, f.length = 3 ∧ f.Nodup) ∧
      (∀ f ∈ k.cell.tris, f.length = 3 ∧ f.Nodup) ∧ k.cell.splits.length ≠ 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {l : List α}, (l.all p = true) = ∀ x ∈ l, p x = true

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a b : α}, ((a == b) = true) = (a = b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_4
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape._simp_1_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a b : α}, ((a != b) = true) = (a ≠ b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape2.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape2.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape2.eq_1.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shape2 k =
    ((((k.tets.all fun t => t.length == 4 && decide t.Nodup) &&
          (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.quadTris k.cell).all fun f => f.length == 3 && decide f.Nodup) &&
        k.cell.tris.all fun f => f.length == 3 && decide f.Nodup) &&
      k.cell.splits.length != 0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share.type: {ι : Type} → [DecidableEq ι] → CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι → Finset ι → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share._proof_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share._proof_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share._proof_1.type: ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι], LawfulBEq (Finset ι × Bool)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share.eq_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (c : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι) (S : Finset ι),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share c S =
    if (S, true) ∈ c.faceTris then 1 / 2 else if (S, false) ∈ c.faceTris then 1 else 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shareZ.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shareZ
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shareZ.type: (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) → Fin k.n → Fin k.n → Fin k.n → ℤ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (c : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin c.kind.n),
  a0 ≠ a1 →
    a0 ≠ a2 →
      a1 ≠ a2 →
        CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share c {c.glob a0, c.glob a1, c.glob a2} =
          ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.shareZ c.kind a0 a1 a2) / (2 * ↑c.kind.cell.splits.length)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_4
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_5
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_6
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp_1_7
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_eq._simp.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_of_mem.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_of_mem
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share_of_mem.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (c : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Cell ι) (S : Finset ι) (fl : Bool),
  (S, fl) ∈ c.faceTris → CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.share c S = if fl = true then 1 / 2 else 1

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideF_aff.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideF_aff
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideF_aff.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (f : List (Fin k.n))
  (v : Fin k.n),
  CFDLean.JST1.Spec.sideF (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b) f (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b v) =
    A.det * ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF k f v)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideF_cen.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideF_cen
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideF_cen.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (f : List (Fin k.n)),
  CFDLean.JST1.Spec.sideF (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b) f (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)
      ((1 / ↑k.n) • ∑ a, CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a) =
    A.det * (1 / ↑k.n * ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.cF k f))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_affine.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_affine
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_affine.type:
∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b u v w x : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3),
  CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (A.mulVec u + b) (A.mulVec v + b) (A.mulVec w + b) (A.mulVec x + b) =
    A.det * CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf u v w x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cast.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cast
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cast.type:
∀ (a b c x : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.Z3),
  CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 a) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 b)
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 c) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 x) =
    ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ a b c x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen.type:
∀ (a b c s : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.Z3) (n : ℕ),
  n ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 a) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 b)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 c) ((1 / ↑n) • CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 s) =
      1 / ↑n *
        ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.dtZ
            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.crsZ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ b a) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ c a))
            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ s (↑n * a.1, ↑n * a.2.1, ↑n * a.2.2)))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_10
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_11
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_12
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_13
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_7
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_8
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._simp_1_9
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideOf_cen._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ.eq_1.type:
∀ (xa xb xc x : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.Z3),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ xa xb xc x =
    CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.dtZ
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.crsZ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ xb xa) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ xc xa))
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ x xa)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.side_aff.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.side_aff
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.side_aff.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (a0 a1 a2 v : Fin k.n),
  CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a0) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a1)
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a2) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b v) =
    A.det *
      ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a0) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a1)
          (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a2) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k v))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.side_cen.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.side_cen
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.side_cen.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin k.n),
  CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a0) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a1)
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a2) ((1 / ↑k.n) • ∑ a, CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.affX k A b a) =
    A.det * (1 / ↑k.n * ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.cenZ k a0 a1 a2))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ.eq_1.type: ∀ (a b : CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.Z3), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.subZ a b = (a.1 - b.1, a.2.1 - b.2.1, a.2.2 - b.2.2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sum_four.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sum_four
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sum_four.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (t : List (Fin n)) (z : Fin n), t.length = 4 → ∀ (G : Fin n → ℝ), ∑ o, G (t.getD (↑o) z) = (List.map G t).sum

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sum_ref.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sum_ref
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sum_ref.type: ∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind), ∑ a, k.ref a = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.castZ3 (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sumZ k)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ.type: (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) → Fin k.n → Fin k.n → Fin k.n → List (Fin k.n) → ℤ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ_real.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ_real
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.termZ_real.type:
∀ (k : CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.Kind) (a0 a1 a2 : Fin k.n) (t : List (Fin k.n)) (C : ℝ),
  (if (t.contains a0 && t.contains a1 && t.contains a2) = true then
      (List.map
          (fun v =>
            if CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF a0 a1 a2 v = true then 0
            else
              C *
                ↑(CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sideZ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a0)
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a1) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k a2)
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.refZ k v)).sign)
          t).sum
    else 0) =

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.tet_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.tet_sum
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.tet_sum.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (g : Fin n ↪ ι) (t : List (Fin n)) (z : Fin n),
  t.length = 4 →
    t.Nodup →
      ∀ (e : Fin 4 ↪ ι),
        (∀ (a : Fin 4), e a = g (t.getD (↑a) z)) →
          ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : Fin n),
            a0 ≠ a1 →
              a0 ≠ a2 →
                a1 ≠ a2 →
                  ∀ (F : Fin n → ℝ),
                    (∑ o, if Finset.map e (Finset.univ.erase o) = {g a0, g a1, g a2} then F (t.getD (↑o) z) else 0) =
                      if (t.contains a0 && t.contains a1 && t.contains a2) = true then
                        (List.map (fun v => if CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.inF a0 a1 a2 v = true then 0 else F v) t).sum
                      else 0

      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, S.φ q k = 1) →

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.phiN_beta.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.phiN_beta
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.phiN_beta.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) {Q : Type}
  [inst_2 : Fintype Q] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C] (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (fq : Q → C × Fin (d + 1)) (aq : Q → ℝ)
  (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.FacetBalanced bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), bd (fq q) = true) →
          (∀ (q : Q), ∀ k ∉ M.facetNodes (fq q), φ q k = 0) →
            (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                bd p = true → ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i else 0) = 1 / ↑d) →
              (∀ (q : Q), N q = aq q • M.areaVec (fq q)) → ∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = M.beta i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.vw_local.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.vw_local
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.vw_local.type:
∀ {ι C Q : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [Fintype Q] {d : ℕ}
  (S : CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Data ι C Q d) (u : ι → CFDLean.JST1.State d) (i : ι),
  CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.visc S u i + CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wall S u i =
    ∑ T,
      ∑ a,
        if (S.M.vert T) a = i then
          S.M.ω T •
            (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Rvisc (S.M.simplex T) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.K S u T) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wloc S u T) a +
              CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Rwall (S.M.simplex T) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.K S u T) S.P S.gw (S.walls T) S.c
                (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wloc S u T) a)
        else 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.vw_pair.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.vw_pair
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.vw_pair.type:
∀ {ι C Q : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype Q] {d : ℕ}
  (S : CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Data ι C Q d) (u : ι → CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  ∑ i,
      CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.w S u i)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.visc S u i + CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wall S u i) =
    ∑ T,
      S.M.ω T *
        ∑ b,
          CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wloc S u T b)
            (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Rvisc (S.M.simplex T) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.K S u T) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wloc S u T) b +
              CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Rwall (S.M.simplex T) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.K S u T) S.P S.gw (S.walls T) S.c
                (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.wloc S u T) b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k : ℝ),
  p0 ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW g.γ r0 p0 (CFDLean.Num.dot v v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E) k v E)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF g.γ r0 p0 (CFDLean.Num.dot v v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E) k v
          E) =
      r0 *
        (g.γ * CFDLean.Num.dot v E + r0 / p0 * k ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot E E * CFDLean.Num.dot v E +
          2 * g.γ * k * CFDLean.Num.dot E E)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_10
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_1.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_11

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_1.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq._simp_1_1.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass = r0 * (vn + k * L2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
    (r0 * vn + r0 * k * L2) * v α + (r0 * k * vn + p0 * γ) * E α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =
    (p0 * γ / (γ - 1) + r0 * A / 2 + r0 * k * vn + p0 * γ) * vn + (p0 / (γ - 1) + r0 * A / 2 + p0) * (k * L2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass =
    -(r0 * ((1 - γ) * A + 2 * k * vn)) / (2 * p0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
    r0 * (1 - γ) / p0 * v α + r0 * k / p0 * E α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy = -(r0 * (1 - γ)) / p0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.match_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.match_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.match_1.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  (motive : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d → Sort u_1) →
    (x : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) →
      (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass) →
        ((α : Fin d) → motive (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)) →
          (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy) → motive x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_V.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_V
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_V.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (k t : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.Num.dot (fun α => v α + t * (k * E α)) fun α => v α + t * (k * E α)) =
    CFDLean.Num.dot v v + t * (2 * k * CFDLean.Num.dot v E) + t ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot E E)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_V._simp_1_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_V._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_V._simp_1_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_VE.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_VE
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_VE.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (k t : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (fun α => v α + t * (k * E α)) E = CFDLean.Num.dot v E + t * (k * CFDLean.Num.dot E E)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_VE._simp_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_VE._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dot_VE._simp_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dotmom_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dotmom_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dotmom_path.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k t : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t)) E =
    r0 * (1 + t) * (CFDLean.Num.dot v E + t * (k * CFDLean.Num.dot E E))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.energy_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.energy_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.energy_path.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k t : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.energy (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t) =
    p0 * (1 + g.γ * t) / (g.γ - 1) +
      r0 * (1 + t) * (CFDLean.Num.dot v v + t * (2 * k * CFDLean.Num.dot v E) + t ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot E E)) /
        2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.exists_near.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.exists_near
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.exists_near.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g U →
    ∀ (k : ℝ) {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ {S : Set ℝ},
          IsOpen S →
            CFDLean.JST1.rho U *
                  (g.γ * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E +
                      CFDLean.JST1.rho U / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U * k ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot E E *
                        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E +
                    2 * g.γ * k * CFDLean.Num.dot E E) ∈
                S →
              ∃ t,
                t ≠ 0 ∧
                  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                        (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t) ∧
                    ‖CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                              (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t -
                            U‖ <
                        ε ∧
                      CFDLean.Num.pairF
                            (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g
                                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t) -
                              CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g U)
                            (CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g
                                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t)
                                E -
                              CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g U E) /
                          t ^ 2 ∈
                        S

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.hf_all.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.hf_all
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.hf_all.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k : ℝ),

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.hf_mom.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.mom_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.mom_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.mom_path.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k t : ℝ) (α : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.mom (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t) α = r0 * (1 + t) * (v α + t * (k * E α))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.Gas → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k t : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t =
    CFDLean.JST1.primState g (r0 * (1 + t)) (fun α => v α + t * (k * E α)) (p0 * (1 + g.γ * t))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path_cont.type:

  Continuous fun t => CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.pressure_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.pressure_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.pressure_path.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k : ℝ) {t : ℝ},
  r0 * (1 + t) ≠ 0 → CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t) = p0 * (1 + g.γ * t)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.rho_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.rho_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.rho_path.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k t : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t) = r0 * (1 + t)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.slope_prod.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.slope_prod
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.slope_prod.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] (f h : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (f' h' : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), HasDerivAt (f i) (f' i) 0) →
    (∀ (i : ι), HasDerivAt (h i) (h' i) 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (∑ i, (f i t - f i 0) * (h i t - h i 0)) / t ^ 2) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ)
        (nhds (∑ i, f' i * h' i))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (x y z u : ℝ),
  ∑ α, (x * v α + y * E α) * (z * v α + u * E α) =
    x * z * CFDLean.Num.dot v v + (x * u + y * z) * CFDLean.Num.dot v E + y * u * CFDLean.Num.dot E E

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin._simp_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin._simp_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.vel_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.vel_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.vel_path.type:

  r0 * (1 + t) ≠ 0 → CFDLean.JST1.vel (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g r0 v E p0 k t) = fun α => v α + t * (k * E α)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Dg7.frob_add.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (A B H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ), CFDLean.Num.frob (A + B) H = CFDLean.Num.frob A H + CFDLean.Num.frob B H

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Dg7.ne_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Dg7.ne_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Dg7.ne_nonneg.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), 0 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T * M.m T * CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v else 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e.type:

  M.Valid → ∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) (M.e i k) = M.mu i k

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e'.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e'._s.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e'._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c_e'._s.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.e_self.type: ∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i : ι), M.e i i = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.gdot.type:

      CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T a) (M.pos ((M.vert T) b) - M.pos ((M.vert T) c)) =

∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (T : C), 0 ≤ M.ω T * M.m T

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.State d → Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ → Fin d → Fin d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF_add.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF_add
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ) (α β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb (G + H) α β = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β + CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb H α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF_smul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF_smul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF_smul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (c : ℝ) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ) (α β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb (c • G) α β = c * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cos02.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cos02
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cos02.type:
∀ (a b h : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      0 < h →
        CFDLean.JST1.Spec.cosDih (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.sliverBrick a b h) 0 2 = -1 / √(1 + h ^ 2 / a ^ 2 + h ^ 2 / b ^ 2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cos13.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cos13
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cos13.type:
∀ (a b h : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      0 < h →
        CFDLean.JST1.Spec.cosDih (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.sliverBrick a b h) 1 3 =
          -1 / √((1 + h ^ 2 / b ^ 2) * (1 + h ^ 2 / a ^ 2))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cross_dot_left.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cross_dot_left
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cross_dot_left.type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3), CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) u = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cross_dot_right.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cross_dot_right
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.cross_dot_right.type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3), CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) v = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.det_edge3.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.det_edge3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.det_edge3.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3),
  T.edgeMat.det = CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x 1 - T.x 0) (T.x 2 - T.x 0)) (T.x 3 - T.x 0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.dot_comm'.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.dot_comm'
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.dot_comm'.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u v = CFDLean.Num.dot v u

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.dot_self_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.dot_self_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.dot_self_nonneg.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), 0 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot u u

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2)
          else 1 / 2) •
          CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.grads_of_dual.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.grads_of_dual
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.grads_of_dual.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (G : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a j : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot (G a) (T.x j - T.x 0) = (if a = j then 1 else 0) - if a = 0 then 1 else 0) →
    T.Nondeg ∧ ∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), T.grad a = G a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.grads_of_dual._.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.grads_of_dual._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.grads_of_dual._.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n}, (a.succ = b.succ) = (a = b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.lagrange.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.lagrange
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.lagrange.type:
∀ (u v w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot g w • CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v + CFDLean.Num.dot g u • CFDLean.Num.cross3 v w +
      CFDLean.Num.dot g v • CFDLean.Num.cross3 w u =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) w • g

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.sliver_grads.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.sliver_grads
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.sliver_grads.type:
∀ (a b h : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      0 < h →
        (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.sliverBrick a b h).Nondeg ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin (3 + 1)), (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.sliverBrick a b h).grad i = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.sliverG a b h i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm.type:
∀ (p : Fin 4 → CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        -CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm._si.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sbp6.prim_pressure.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sbp6.prim_pressure
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sbp6.prim_pressure.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r : ℝ),
  0 < r → ∀ (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.primState g r v p) = p

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  ∑ α, ∑ β, D.Gv α β * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.tau D α β = (D.μ + D.μt) * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  D.R ≠ 0 →
    D.T ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Pi D =
        -CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.theta D *
              (D.μ * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D + (D.μt * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D - D.Pk) + D.ε) -
            D.κ * CFDLean.Num.dot D.GT D.GT / (D.R * D.T ^ 2) +
          if D.withDk = true then 0 else -(D.Dk * CFDLean.Num.dot D.Gk (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Gtheta D))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D = ∑ α, ∑ β, D.Gv α β * (D.Gv α β + D.Gv β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D.Gv γ γ) ^ 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.admissible_con.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.admissible_convex
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.admissible_con.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas), Convex ℝ {u | CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g u}

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.admissible_con.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.admissible_convex._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.admissible_con.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.euler_strict.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.euler_strict
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.euler_strict.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {U1 U2 : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g U1 →
    CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g U2 →
      CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g U2 - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g U1) (U2 - U1) = 0 → U1 = U2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hatL_apply.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hatL_apply
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hatL_apply.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (U : CFDLean.JST1.SState d), (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hatL d) U = CFDLean.JST1.hatState U

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_add.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_add
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (U V : CFDLean.JST1.SState d),
  CFDLean.JST1.hatState (U + V) = CFDLean.JST1.hatState U + CFDLean.JST1.hatState V

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_smul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_smul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_smul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.JST1.SState d), CFDLean.JST1.hatState (a • U) = a • CFDLean.JST1.hatState U

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_sub.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_sub
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.hat_sub.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (U V : CFDLean.JST1.SState d),
  CFDLean.JST1.hatState (U - V) = CFDLean.JST1.hatState U - CFDLean.JST1.hatState V

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.log_mul_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.log_mul_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.log_mul_nonneg.type: ∀ {r1 r2 : ℝ}, 0 < r1 → 0 < r2 → 0 ≤ (Real.log r2 - Real.log r1) * (r2 - r1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.log_mul_pos.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.log_mul_pos
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.log_mul_pos.type: ∀ {r1 r2 : ℝ}, 0 < r1 → 0 < r2 → r1 ≠ r2 → 0 < (Real.log r2 - Real.log r1) * (r2 - r1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pairCLM_apply.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pairCLM_apply
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pairCLM_apply.type: ∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (w x : κ → ℝ), (CFDLean.Num.pairCLM w) x = CFDLean.Num.pairF w x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pairF_sub_left.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pairF_sub_left
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pairF_sub_left.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (x - y) z = CFDLean.Num.pairF x z - CFDLean.Num.pairF y z

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pair_vEta.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pair_vEta
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pair_vEta.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U R : CFDLean.JST1.SState d),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.vEta g U) R =
    CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState U)) (CFDLean.JST1.hatState R)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pair_vEta_diff.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pair_vEta_diff
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.pair_vEta_diff.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U1 U2 : CFDLean.JST1.SState d),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.vEta g U2 - CFDLean.JST1.vEta g U1) (U2 - U1) =
    CFDLean.Num.pairF
      (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState U2) - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState U1))
      (CFDLean.JST1.hatState U2 - CFDLean.JST1.hatState U1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.sadm_convex.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.sadm_convex
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.sadm_convex.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas), Convex ℝ {U | CFDLean.JST1.SAdmissible g U}

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.type: (d : ℕ) → CFDLean.JST1.SChan d ≃ CFDLean.JST1.Channel d ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._proof_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (c : CFDLean.JST1.SChan d),
  (match
      match c with
      | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c => Sum.inl c
      | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke => Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())
      | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg => Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()) with
    | Sum.inl c => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg) =
    c

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._proof_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (x : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit),
  (match
      match x with
      | Sum.inl c => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inl val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inr val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg with
    | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c => Sum.inl c
    | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke => Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())
    | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg => Sum.inr (Sum.inr ())) =
    x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.eq_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.eq_.type:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv d =
    {
      toFun := fun x =>
        match x with
        | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c => Sum.inl c
        | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke => Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())
        | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg => Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()),
      invFun := fun x =>
        match x with
        | Sum.inl c => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c
        | Sum.inr (Sum.inl val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke
        | Sum.inr (Sum.inr val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg,
      left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ }

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.mat.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.match_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.mat.type:
(d : ℕ) →
  (motive : CFDLean.JST1.SChan d → Sort u_1) →
    (x : CFDLean.JST1.SChan d) →
      ((c : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) → motive (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c)) →
        (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke) → (Unit → motive CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg) → motive x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.mat.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.match_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.mat.type:
(d : ℕ) →
  (motive : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit → Sort u_1) →
    (x : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit) →
      ((c : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) → motive (Sum.inl c)) →
        ((val : Unit) → motive (Sum.inr (Sum.inl val))) → ((val : Unit) → motive (Sum.inr (Sum.inr val))) → motive x

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.sum_schan.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.sum_schan
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.sum_schan.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (f : CFDLean.JST1.SChan d → ℝ),
  ∑ c, f c = ∑ c, f (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c) + f CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke + f CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.tau_symm.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.tau_symm
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.tau_symm.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d) (α β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.tau D α β = CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.tau D β α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_eq_zero.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_eq_zero
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_eq_zero.type:
∀ {γ : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ},
      0 < r1 → 0 < p1 → 0 < r2 → 0 < p2 → CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2 = 0 → r1 = r2 ∧ p1 = p2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_mul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_mul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_mul.type:
∀ {γ : ℝ},
  γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ),
      (γ - 1) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2 =
        -((CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.entS γ r2 p2 - CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.entS γ r1 p1) * (r2 - r1) +
            (r2 / p2 - r1 / p1) * (p2 - p1))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.thQ_nonneg.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ}, 0 < r1 → 0 < p1 → 0 < r2 → 0 < p2 → 0 ≤ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.two_SS.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.two_SS
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.two_SS.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  2 * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.SS D = ∑ α, ∑ β, D.Gv α β * (D.Gv α β + D.Gv β α)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.two_SS._simp_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.two_SS._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.two_SS._simp_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.fhat_pair.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.fhat_pair
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.fhat_pair.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ)
  (P : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (gw : κ → ℝ) (walls : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ) (w : Fin (d + 1) → κ → ℝ) (o b : Fin (d + 1)),
  P.transpose = P →
    P * P = P →
      CFDLean.Num.pairF (w b) (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Fhat T K P gw walls c w o b) =
        CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w b)
              ((K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w)).mulVec (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o)) -
            CFDLean.JST1.Wall.sigmaF T walls c o *
              CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w b) (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))
                (K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w b) (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))) +
          CFDLean.Num.pairF gw (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Fhat T K P gw walls c w o b)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.fhat_pair._abel_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.fhat_pair._abel_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.fhat_pair._abel_.type: ∀ {κ : Type} {d : ℕ} (gw : κ → ℝ) (w : Fin (d + 1) → κ → ℝ) (b : Fin (d + 1)), w b = w b - gw + gw

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_add_l.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_add_l
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_add_l.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {ι : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (A B C : Matrix κ ι ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.frob (A + B) C = CFDLean.Num.frob A C + CFDLean.Num.frob B C

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_add_r.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_add_r
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_add_r.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {ι : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (A B C : Matrix κ ι ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.frob A (B + C) = CFDLean.Num.frob A B + CFDLean.Num.frob A C

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_grad.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_grad
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_grad.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (w : Fin (d + 1) → κ → ℝ) (M : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w) M = ∑ b, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w b) (M.mulVec (T.grad b))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_outer.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_outer
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_outer.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (e : κ → ℝ) (N : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (M : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e N) M = CFDLean.Num.pairF e (M.mulVec N)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_smul_l.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_smul_l
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_smul_l.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {ι : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (c : ℝ) (A B : Matrix κ ι ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.frob (c • A) B = c * CFDLean.Num.frob A B

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_smul_r.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_smul_r
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_smul_r.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sub_l.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sub_l
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sub_l.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sub_r.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sub_r
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sub_r.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sum_l.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sum_l
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.frob_sum_l.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {ι : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {Q : Type} (s : Finset Q) (A : Q → Matrix κ ι ℝ)
  (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ), CFDLean.Num.frob (∑ q ∈ s, A q) B = ∑ q ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.frob (A q) B

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.grad_dot_pos.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.grad_dot_pos
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.grad_dot_pos.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d), 1 ≤ d → T.Nondeg → ∀ (o : Fin (d + 1)), 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad o) (T.grad o)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.node_bound.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.node_bound
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wl9.node_bound.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  IsLinearMap ℝ K →
    (∀ (G H : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ), CFDLean.Num.frob G (K H) = CFDLean.Num.frob H (K G)) →
      (∀ (G : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ), 0 ≤ CFDLean.Num.frob G (K G)) →
        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (Y G : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
          σ * (2 * CFDLean.Num.frob Y (K G) - σ * CFDLean.Num.frob Y (K Y)) ≤ CFDLean.Num.frob G (K G)

    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr val) => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy) =
    c

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.channelEquiv._proof_.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.channelEquiv._proof_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.channelEquiv._proof_.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (s : Unit ⊕ Fin d ⊕ Unit),
  (match
      match s with
      | Sum.inl val => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inl α) => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inr val) => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy with
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass => Sum.inl ()
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α => Sum.inr (Sum.inl α)
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy => Sum.inr (Sum.inr ())) =
    s

        | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α => Sum.inr (Sum.inl α)
        | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy => Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()),

        match s with
        | Sum.inl val => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass
        | Sum.inr (Sum.inl α) => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α
        | Sum.inr (Sum.inr val) => CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy,

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.decomp_rest.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.decomp_rest
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.decomp_rest.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ},
  0 < r1 →
    0 < p1 →
      0 < r2 →
        0 < p2 →
          have Ui := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1;
          have Uk := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r2 p2;
          CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui) (Uk - Ui) =
              CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ g.γ r1 p1 r2 p2 ∧
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui)
                (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Ui) =
              CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt g.γ r1 p1 r2 p2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.type:
∀ (γ μ ν ds db B R : ℝ),
  B ≠ 0 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      R / (γ - 1) *
          (μ * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1) - db / B) +
            ν * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1) - db / B)) =
        -((μ + ν) * ds * (R * (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1))) +
              (μ + γ * ν) * db * ((R * (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) * B - R * db) / B ^ 2)) /
          (γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.dot_lin2_l.type:

  CFDLean.Num.dot (fun α => (za * va α + zb * vb α) / 2 / m) y =
    za / 2 / m * CFDLean.Num.dot va y + zb / 2 / m * CFDLean.Num.dot vb y

    za / 2 / m * CFDLean.Num.dot x va + zb / 2 / m * CFDLean.Num.dot x vb

  T.Nondeg → ∀ (i k : Fin 3), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dualFacet2 T i k = (T.vol / 3) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_energy_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_energy_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_energy_eq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {U : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.rho U ≠ 0 →
    U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =
      CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U / (g.γ - 1) +
        CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) / 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_pairF_channel.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_pairF_channel
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_pairF_channel.type:

  CFDLean.Num.pairF x y =
    x CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass * y CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass +
        ∑ α, x (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) * y (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) +
      x CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy * y CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.e1_sum_channel.type:

  ∑ c, f c = f CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass + ∑ α, f (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) + f CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.entS.eq_1.type: ∀ (γ r p : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.entS γ r p = Real.log p - γ * Real.log r

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.enth_mom.type:

  (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
    (Uk - Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.type:
∀ {γ a b c ε : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    0 < CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b →
      CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b = c * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ h,
            0 < CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) ∧
              CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) <
                  (c + ε) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) ∧
                (c - ε) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) <
                  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.frob G (CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb H) =
      CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb * ∑ α, ∑ β, CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β +
        P.κ * ∑ β, G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy β * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DTF P wb H β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.grad_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.grad_sum
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.grad_sum.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d), ∑ a, T.grad a = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.type:
∀ {γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db t : ℝ},
  γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
    0 < CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t →
      HasDerivAt (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pK γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pρ γ s1 ds β1 db t / (γ - 1) *
          (μ *
              CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1))
                (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1) - db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) +
            ν *
              CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1))
                (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1) - db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))
        t

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_dot_smul_l.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (a c : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (r • a) c = r * CFDLean.Num.dot a c

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_energy_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_energy_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_energy_eq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.rho U ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.JST1.energy U =
      CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U / (g.γ - 1) +
        CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) / 2

  CFDLean.JST1.rho U ≠ 0 → CFDLean.JST1.mom U = CFDLean.JST1.rho U • CFDLean.JST1.vel U

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_pairF_channel.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_pairF_channel
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_pairF_channel.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x z : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x z =
    x CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass * z CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass +
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom x) (CFDLean.JST1.mom z) +
      x CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy * z CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ir_sum_channel.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (f : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d → ℝ),
  ∑ c, f c = f CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass + ∑ α, f (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) + f CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ismailRoe_symm.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ua Ub : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe g Ua Ub y = CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe g Ub Ua y

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ismailRoe_tadmor.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ismailRoe_tadmor
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.ismailRoe_tadmor.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ua Ub : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Ua →
    CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Ub →
      CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ub - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ua)
          (CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe g Ua Ub y) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.fluxPot Ub - CFDLean.JST1.fluxPot Ua) y

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.lamHat_smul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (vb : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (cb c : ℝ) (e y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  0 ≤ c → CFDLean.JST1.lamHat vb cb e (c • y) = c * CFDLean.JST1.lamHat vb cb e y

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.lam_quad.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.lam_quad
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.lam_quad.type:
∀ {γ : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.JST1.lamLow γ ^ 2 - (γ + 1) * CFDLean.JST1.lamLow γ + (3 * γ + 1) / 4 = 0 ∧
      CFDLean.JST1.lamHigh γ ^ 2 - (γ + 1) * CFDLean.JST1.lamHigh γ + (3 * γ + 1) / 4 = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_def.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d), CFDLean.JST1.mom U = fun α => U (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk ≠ 0 →
      ∑ α,
          (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) *
            (Uk - Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
        CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk *
              CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) -
            (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui +
                CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) *
              CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) +
          CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui *
            CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui)

  ∑ x ∈ s, f x - ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x - g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum._simp_1_6.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum._simp_1_6
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum._simp_1_6.type:

  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

              (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk) +
            CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk ∧
        CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui)
            (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Ui) =
          CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt g.γ (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)
