CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.quad_nonneg.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (D : Fin d → Fin d → ℝ), d ≤ 3 → 0 ≤ ∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (D α β + D β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D γ γ) ^ 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.radFull_smul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.radFull_smul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.radFull_smul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (vb : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (cb c : ℝ) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  0 ≤ c → CFDLean.JST1.radFull vb cb (c • y) = c * CFDLean.JST1.radFull vb cb y

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.radFull_zero.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.radFull_zero
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.radFull_zero.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (vb : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (cb : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.radFull vb cb 0 = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.Gas → ℝ → ℝ → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r p : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r p = CFDLean.JST1.primState g r 0 p

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.rho_rest.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.rho_rest
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.rho_rest.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r p : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r p) = r

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.rot_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.rot_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.rot_eq.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (i k : Fin 3),
      i ≠ k →
        ∃ σ,
          (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
            CFDLean.Num.rot90 (T.centroid - (1 / 2) • (T.x i + T.x k)) =
              (σ * (T.edgeMat.det / 6)) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_channel.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_channel
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_channel.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {X : Type} [inst : AddCommMonoid X] (f : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d → X),
  ∑ c, f c = f CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass + ∑ α, f (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) + f CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share.type:
∀ {ι σ : Type} [inst : Fintype σ] (ω : σ → ℝ) (χ : σ → ι → ι → Bool) (i k : ι) (X : ℝ),
  (∑ s, ω s * if χ s i k = true then X else 0) = CFDLean.JST1.piShare ω χ i k * X

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_single.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_single

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams → CFDLean.JST1.State d → Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ → Fin d → Fin d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (α β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb (G + H) α β = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β + CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (c : ℝ)
  (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ) (α β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb (c • G) α β = c * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (α β : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G β α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : Fin d → Fin d → ℝ) (μ : ℝ),
  ∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (μ * (D α β + D β α) - (2 / 3 * μ * ∑ γ, D γ γ) * if α = β then 1 else 0) =
    μ * (∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (D α β + D β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D γ γ) ^ 2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.type: ∀ (k : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun h => (Real.exp (h * k) - 1) / h) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds k)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.type:
∀ {γ a b h : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    h ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) / h ^ 2 =
          -((b - γ * a) * ((Real.exp (h * a) - 1) / h) +
                (Real.exp (h * (a - b)) - 1) / h * ((Real.exp (h * b) - 1) / h)) /
            (γ - 1) ∧
        CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) / h ^ 2 =
          -((b - γ * a) * ((Real.exp (h * a) - 1) / h) +
                γ * ((Real.exp (h * (a - b)) - 1) / h) * ((Real.exp (h * b) - 1) / h)) /
            (γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.type: ∀ (γ a b : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b = (b - a) ^ 2 + (γ - 1) * a ^ 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a ≠ 0 → ∀ (b : ℝ), 0 < CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.type:
∀ {γ μ ν : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    (∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b + ν * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b) →
      ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ},
        0 < r1 →
          0 < p1 →
            0 < r2 → 0 < p2 → 0 ≤ μ * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2 + ν * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ r1 p1 r2 p2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.State d → Fin d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      (∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot u (T.x a - T.x 0) = CFDLean.Num.dot v (T.x a - T.x 0)) → u = v

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg → ∀ (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), u = ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.dot u (T.x a - T.x 0) • T.grad a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.Gas → CFDLean.JST1.State d → CFDLean.JST1.State d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk =
    ((CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui +
          CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) *
        ∑ α, (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α - CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α) ^ 2) /
      2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Ui → CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Uk → 0 ≤ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r2 p2) = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r p : ℝ) (α : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.vel (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r p) α = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  ∑ α, (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α - CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α) ^ 2 =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) -
        2 * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) +
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum._simp_1_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum._simp_1_2.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f g : ι → G),
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x - ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x - g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum._simp_1_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum._simp_1_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum._simp_1_3.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_energy.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_energy
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_energy.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy β =
    ∑ α, CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G β α * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF wb α + P.κ * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DTF P wb G β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_mass.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_mass
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_mass.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (β : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass β = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_mom.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_mom
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.viscFlux_mom.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (α β : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb G (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) β = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.zfacts.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.zfacts
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.zfacts.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g U →
    0 < √(CFDLean.JST1.rho U / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) ∧
      0 < √(CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) ∧
        CFDLean.JST1.rho U =
            √(CFDLean.JST1.rho U / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) * √(CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) ∧
          CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U =
            √(CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) / √(CFDLean.JST1.rho U / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)

CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ)
  (P : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (gw : κ → ℝ) (walls : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ) (w : Fin (d + 1) → κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw walls c w =
    ∑ o ∈ walls,
      (2 * (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o / ↑d) *
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase o,
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w a)
              ((K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w)).mulVec (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o)) -
        CFDLean.JST1.Wall.sigmaF T walls c o * CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Xf T K P gw w o)

  CFDLean.JST1.entropyFun g U = -CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.JST1.physEntropy g U / (g.γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars.eq_1.type:

  CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass =
    (g.γ - CFDLean.JST1.physEntropy g U) / (g.γ - 1) -
      CFDLean.JST1.rho U * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) / (2 * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)

CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.Gas → CFDLean.JST1.State d → CFDLean.JST1.State d → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ua Ub : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe g Ua Ub y = fun c =>
    match c with
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
          CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
            √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          (fun α =>
            (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                2 /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                2))
          y
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
              CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
            (fun α =>
                (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                    2 /
                  ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2))
              α *
          CFDLean.Num.dot
            (fun α =>
              (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                  2 /
                ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                  2))
            y +
        (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
              2 /
            ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
              2) *
          y α
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
            CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
              √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
          (g.γ *
                ((g.γ + 1) / (2 * g.γ) *
                    (CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) /
                      CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) +
                  (g.γ - 1) / (2 * g.γ) *
                    ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                          √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                        2 /
                      ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                          √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                        2))) /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2 *
                  CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
                (g.γ - 1)) +
            (CFDLean.Num.dot
                (fun α =>
                  (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                      2 /
                    ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                      2))
                fun α =>
                (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                    2 /
                  ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2)) /
              2) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          (fun α =>
            (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                2 /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                2))
          y

CFDLean.JST1.physFlux.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.physFlux.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.physFlux.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (a : Fin d),

    CFDLean.JST1.mom U a * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) y + CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U * y a

CFDLean.JST1.physFlux.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g U y CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =

CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux g U y (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) = CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U * y α

CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (x : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d),
  (∀ (α : Fin d), x = CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α → False) → CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux g U y x = 0

CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.match_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.match_1
CFDLean.JST1.pressFlux.match_1.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  (motive : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d → Sort u_1) →
    (x : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) →
      ((α : Fin d) → motive (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)) → ((x : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) → motive x) → motive x

CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U =
    (g.γ - 1) *
      (CFDLean.JST1.energy U - CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) / (2 * CFDLean.JST1.rho U))

CFDLean.JST1.primState.name: CFDLean.JST1.primState
CFDLean.JST1.primState.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.Gas → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → ℝ → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.primState g r v p CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass = r

CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p : ℝ) (a : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.primState g r v p (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum a) = r * v a

CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3
CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.primState g r v p CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy = p / (g.γ - 1) + r * CFDLean.Num.dot v v / 2

CFDLean.JST1.radFull.name: CFDLean.JST1.radFull
CFDLean.JST1.radFull.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.radFull.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.radFull.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.radFull.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (vb : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (cb : ℝ) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.radFull vb cb y = |CFDLean.Num.dot vb y| + cb * CFDLean.Num.len y

CFDLean.JST1.rho.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d), CFDLean.JST1.rho U = U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass

CFDLean.JST1.vEta.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.vEta.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.vEta.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.SState d) (a : CFDLean.JST1.Channel d),
  CFDLean.JST1.vEta g U (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow a) = CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState U) a

CFDLean.JST1.vEta.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.vEta.eq_2

CFDLean.JST1.vel.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.vel.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.vel.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (α : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.vel U α = CFDLean.JST1.mom U α / CFDLean.JST1.rho U

CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.boundary_per.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.boundary_perturbation
CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.boundary_per.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (b₀ : M.Boundary) (δ : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
      CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ (fun x => U) M.edgeArea)
          (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b) + if b = b₀ then δ else 0) (↑b₀).2 =
        δ

CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.compatible_s.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.compatible_standard
CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.compatible_s.type:
∀ (a : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.interfaces
      (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.interfaces 2
        (fun x => CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.resting) CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.edgeArea)
      (fun b =>
        (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.resting)
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.boundaryArea b))
      a =
    0

CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.incompatible.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.incompatible_standard
CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.incompatible.type:
CFDLean.Assembly.residual CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.interfaces
    (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.interfaces 2
      (fun x => CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.resting) CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.edgeArea)
    (fun b =>
      (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.resting)
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standard.boundaryArea b) +
        if b = CFDLean.MedianDual.Controls.standardBoundary then ![1, 0, 0, 0, 0] else 0)
    0 ≠
  0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Conforming.c.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  {M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m} →
    {motive : M.Conforming → Sort u} →
      (t : M.Conforming) →
        ((uniqueCells : Function.Injective M.cellNodes) →
            (injectiveUsed : ∀ (a b : Fin n), M.Used a → M.Used b → M.position a = M.position b → a = b) →
              (intersections :
                  ∀ (t u : Fin m),
                    t ≠ u →
                      (convexHull ℝ) (Set.range (M.points t)) ∩ (convexHull ℝ) (Set.range (M.points u)) =
                        (convexHull ℝ) (M.position '' ↑(M.cellNodes t ∩ M.cellNodes u))) →
                (faceMultiplicity : ∀ (F : Finset (Fin n)), M.faceCount F ≤ 2) →
                  (oppositeSides :
                      ∀ (a b : M.Occurrence),
                        a ≠ b →
                          M.faceID a = M.faceID b →
                            0 <
                              CFDLean.dot (M.faceArea a) (M.position (M.oppositeNode b) - M.position (M.baseNode a))) →
                    motive ⋯) →
          motive t
