CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Conforming.u.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} {M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m}, M.Conforming → Function.Injective M.cellNodes

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Edge.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Edge
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Edge.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Type

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Interior.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Interior
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Interior.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Type

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → Fin n → Prop

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  M.IsEdge a b = (a < b ∧ ∃ t, a ∈ M.cellNodes t ∧ b ∈ M.cellNodes t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Occurrence.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Occurrence
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Occurrence.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Type

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Used.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Used
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Used.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → Prop

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData._sizeOf_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData._sizeOf_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData._sizeOf_1.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → ℕ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_boundary
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming → ∀ (i : Fin n), ∑ a, M.ownedPatch a i = ∑ b, if (↑b).2 = i then M.boundaryArea b else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_boundary._proof_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  0 < M.faceCount (M.faceID a) →
    M.faceCount (M.faceID a) ≤ 2 → ¬(M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 1 ∨ M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 2) → False

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_local
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  ∑ o, M.ownedPatch o a =
    ∑ t, ∑ i, if (M.vertex t) i = a then ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch (M.points t) j i else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  M.assembledArea a b =
    ∑ t,
      ∑ i,
        ∑ j, if (M.vertex t) i = a ∧ (M.vertex t) j = b then CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface (M.points t) i j else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_reverse
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n), M.assembledArea b a = -M.assembledArea a b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_reverse._simp_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f : ι → G),
  -∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, -f x

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_row
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  ∑ b, M.assembledArea a b =
    ∑ t, ∑ i, if (M.vertex t) i = a then ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface (M.points t) i j else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_self
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), M.assembledArea a a = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_support
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  (¬∃ t, a ∈ M.cellNodes t ∧ b ∈ M.cellNodes t) → M.assembledArea a b = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → Fin n

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), M.baseNode a = (M.vertex a.1) (a.2.succAbove 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), M.baseNode a ∈ M.faceID a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Boundary → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), M.boundaryArea b = (1 / 3) • M.faceArea (↑b).1

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Boundary → Finset (Fin n) × Fin n

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey..name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey..type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), M.boundaryKey b = (M.faceID (↑b).1, (↑b).2)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_injective
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Function.Injective M.boundaryKey

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_range
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n),
  (∃ b, M.boundaryKey b = (F, i)) ↔ M.faceCount F = 1 ∧ i ∈ F

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_range._proof_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)), M.faceCount F = 1 → ¬0 < M.faceCount F → False

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (i : Fin n),
  (∑ b, if (↑b).2 = i then M.boundaryArea b else 0) = ∑ a, if M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 1 then M.ownedPatch a i else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.casesOn.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.casesOn
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.casesOn.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) →
      ((position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) →
          (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) →
            (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)) →
              motive { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive }) →
        motive t

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin m → Finset (Fin n)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), M.cellNodes t = Finset.map (M.vertex t) Finset.univ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_ca.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_card
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_ca.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), (M.cellNodes t).card = 4

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_p.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_pos
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_p.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_sta.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_state
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_sta.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (a : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ (fun x => U) M.edgeArea)
          (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)) a =
        0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ctorIdx.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ctorIdx
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ctorIdx.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → ℕ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → ℝ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_f.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_formula
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_f.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  M.dualVolume a = ∑ t, if a ∈ M.cellNodes t then CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t) / 4 else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_p.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_pos
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_p.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), M.Used a → 0 < M.dualVolume a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_u.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_unused
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_u.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), ¬M.Used a → M.dualVolume a = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edgeArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edgeArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edgeArea.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Edge → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_inciden.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_incidence_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_inciden.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  ∑ e, ((if (↑e).1 = a then 1 else 0) - if (↑e).2 = a then 1 else 0) • M.edgeArea e = ∑ b, M.assembledArea a b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_sy.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_symm
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_sy.type: ∀ {a b : CFDLean.Vector 3}, a = b ∨ a = -b → b = a ∨ b = -a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_tr.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_trans
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_tr.type: ∀ {a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3}, a = b ∨ a = -b → b = c ∨ b = -c → a = c ∨ a = -c

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  M.faceArea a = CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (M.points a.1) a.2

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_can.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_cancel
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_can.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming → ∀ (a b : M.Occurrence), a ≠ b → M.faceID a = M.faceID b → M.faceArea b = -M.faceArea a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_can.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_cancel_of_side
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_can.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : M.Occurrence),
  M.faceID a = M.faceID b →
    0 < CFDLean.dot (M.faceArea a) (M.position (M.oppositeNode b) - M.position (M.baseNode a)) →
      M.faceArea b = -M.faceArea a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_eq_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_eq_or_neg
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_eq_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : M.Occurrence),
  M.faceID a = M.faceID b → M.faceArea b = M.faceArea a ∨ M.faceArea b = -M.faceArea a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Finset (Fin n) → ℕ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_le.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_le_cells
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_le.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)), M.faceCount F ≤ m

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_on.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_one_unique
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_on.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : M.Occurrence),
  M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 1 → M.faceID b = M.faceID a → a = b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_po.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_pos
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceCount_po.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), 0 < M.faceCount (M.faceID a)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceID.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceID
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceID.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → Finset (Fin n)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceID.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceID.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceID.eq_1.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), M.faceID a = M.faceNodes a.1 a.2

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin m → Fin 4 → Finset (Fin n)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes.eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes.eq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (j : Fin 4),
  M.faceNodes t j = Finset.map (M.vertex t) (Finset.univ.erase j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_ca.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_card
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_ca.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (j : Fin 4), (M.faceNodes t j).card = 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_eq_erase
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_eq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (j : Fin 4),
  M.faceNodes t j = (M.cellNodes t).erase ((M.vertex t) j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_eq_erase._simp_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_eq.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {s : Finset α}, (a ∈ s.erase b) = (a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_in.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_injective
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_in.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), Function.Injective (M.faceNodes t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_subset
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (j : Fin 4), M.faceNodes t j ⊆ M.cellNodes t

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_succAbove
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (j : Fin 4),
  M.faceNodes t j = Finset.map (j.succAboveEmb.trans (M.vertex t)) Finset.univ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_succAbove._simp_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α ↪ β} {s : Finset α} {b : β}, (b ∈ Finset.map f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_succAbove._simp_1_2
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_su.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_tr.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_triple
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceNodes_tr.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  M.faceID a = {(M.vertex a.1) (a.2.succAbove 0), (M.vertex a.1) (a.2.succAbove 1), (M.vertex a.1) (a.2.succAbove 2)}

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceOccurren.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceOccurrences
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceOccurren.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → Finset (Fin n) → Finset M.Occurrence

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceOccurren.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceOccurrences.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceOccurren.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)), M.faceOccurrences F = {a | M.faceID a = F}

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_members.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_membership
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_members.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (F : Finset (Fin n)),
  F.card = 3 → (F ⊆ M.cellNodes t ↔ ∃ j, M.faceNodes t j = F)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 2 → ∃! b, b ≠ a ∧ M.faceID b = M.faceID a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._simp_1_2
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._simp_1_3
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._simp_1_4
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_other._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.index_indica.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.index_indicator
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.index_indica.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid A] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m)
  (s : Finset (Fin 4)) (a : Fin n) (x : A),
  (∑ i ∈ s, if (M.vertex t) i = a then x else 0) = if a ∈ Finset.map (M.vertex t) s then x else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeB.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeBoundary
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeB.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → Fintype M.Boundary

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeB.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeBoundary._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeB.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Finite { x // M.faceCount (M.faceID x.1) = 1 ∧ x.2 ∈ M.faceID x.1 }

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeE.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeEdge
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeE.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → Fintype M.Edge

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeE.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeEdge._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeE.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Finite { x // M.IsEdge x.1 x.2 }

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeI.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeInterior
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeI.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → Fintype M.Interior

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeI.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeInterior._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.instFintypeI.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Finite { x // M.faceCount (M.faceID x) = 2 }

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces (Fin n) M.Edge M.Boundary

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces._.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces._.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (e : M.Edge), (↑e).1 ≠ (↑e).2

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces.e.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interfaces.e.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.interfaces = { tail := fun e => (↑e).1, head := fun e => (↑e).2, distinct := ⋯, owner := fun b => (↑b).2 }

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interior_can.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interior_cancel
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interior_can.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), M.Conforming → ∀ (i : Fin n), ∑ a, M.ownedPatch (↑a) i = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_cellNode.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_cellNodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_cellNode.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (a : Fin n), a ∈ M.cellNodes t ↔ ∃ i, (M.vertex t) i = a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_faceNode.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_faceNodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_faceNode.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (j : Fin 4) (a : Fin n),
  a ∈ M.faceNodes t j ↔ ∃ i, i ≠ j ∧ (M.vertex t) i = a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.metric_close.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.metric_closed
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.metric_close.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming → ∀ (a : Fin n), CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect M.interfaces M.edgeArea M.boundaryArea a = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  (position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) →
    (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) →
      (∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)) →
        CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk._flat_cto.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk._flat_ctor
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk._flat_cto.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  (position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) →
    (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) →
      (∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)) →
        CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.congr_sim.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.congr_simp
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.congr_sim.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (position position_1 : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e_position : position = position_1)
  (vertex vertex_1 : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) (e_vertex : vertex = vertex_1)
  (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)),
  { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive } =
    { position := position_1, vertex := vertex_1, positive := ⋯ }

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.inj.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.inj

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.injEq
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.injEq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n)
  (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i))
  (position_1 : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) (vertex_1 : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n)
  (positive_1 : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position_1 ((vertex_1 t) i)),
  ({ position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive } =
      { position := position_1, vertex := vertex_1, positive := positive_1 }) =
    (position = position_1 ∧ vertex = vertex_1)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.noConfusi.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.noConfusion
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.noConfusi.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3} →
      {vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n} →
        {positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)} →
          {position' : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3} →
            {vertex' : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n} →
              {positive' : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position' ((vertex' t) i)} →
                { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive } =
                    { position := position', vertex := vertex', positive := positive' } →
                  (position ≍ position' → vertex ≍ vertex' → P) → P

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.sizeOf_sp.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.sizeOf_spec
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mk.sizeOf_sp.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n)
  (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)),
  sizeOf { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive } = 1

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusion
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusion.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {n m : ℕ} →
    {t : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m} →
      {n' m' : ℕ} →
        {t' : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n' m'} →
          n = n' → m = m' → t ≍ t' → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusionType P t t'

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusionT.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusionType
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.noConfusionT.type: Sort u → {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → {n' m' : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n' m' → Sort u

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.oppositeNode.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.oppositeNode
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.oppositeNode.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → Fin n

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.oppositeNode.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.oppositeNode.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.oppositeNode.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), M.oppositeNode a = (M.vertex a.1) a.2

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.own_opposite.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.own_opposite_negative
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.own_opposite.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  CFDLean.dot (M.faceArea a) (M.position (M.oppositeNode a) - M.position (M.baseNode a)) < 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch.e.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch.e.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence) (i : Fin n),
  M.ownedPatch a i = if i ∈ M.faceID a then (1 / 3) • M.faceArea a else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch_l.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch_local
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch_l.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence) (i : Fin n),
  M.ownedPatch a i = ∑ j, if (M.vertex a.1) j = i then CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch (M.points a.1) a.2 j else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Interior → M.Interior

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner._pro.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner._pro.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Interior), ∃! b, b ≠ ↑a ∧ M.faceID b = M.faceID ↑a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner._pro.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner._proof_2
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner._pro.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Interior), M.faceCount (M.faceID (Classical.choose ⋯)) = 2

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_face.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_face
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_face.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Interior), M.faceID ↑(M.partner a) = M.faceID ↑a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_invo.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_involutive
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_invo.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Function.Involutive M.partner

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_ne.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_ne
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.partner_ne.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Interior), M.partner a ≠ a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.points.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.points
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.points.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin m → CFDLean.MedianDual.Points

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.points.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.points.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.points.eq_1.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m) (i : Fin 4), M.points t i = M.position ((M.vertex t) i)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.position.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.position
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.position.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.positive.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.positive
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.positive.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (self : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m),
  0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => self.position ((self.vertex t) i)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.rec.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.rec
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.rec.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Sort u} →
    ((position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) →
        (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) →
          (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)) →
            motive { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive }) →
      (t : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → motive t

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.recOn.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.recOn
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.recOn.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) →
      ((position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) →
          (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) →
            (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)) →
              motive { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive }) →
        motive t

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.roe_boundary.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.roe_boundary_balance
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.roe_boundary.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (g : M.Boundary → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ a, CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea) g a = ∑ b, g b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.tangent_at_f.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.tangent_at_face_node
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.tangent_at_f.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  ∀ v ∈ M.faceID a, CFDLean.dot (M.faceArea a) (M.position v - M.position (M.baseNode a)) = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_sam.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_same_nodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_sam.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) (a b c d e f : Fin n),
  {d, e, f} = {a, b, c} →
    d ≠ e ∧ d ≠ f ∧ e ≠ f →
      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x d) (x e) (x f) = CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x a) (x b) (x c) ∨
        CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x d) (x e) (x f) = -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x a) (x b) (x c)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.vertex.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.vertex
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.vertex.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_partition
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming → ∑ a, M.dualVolume a = ∑ t, CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_partition_raw
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), ∑ a, M.dualVolume a = ∑ t, CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averages
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.type:
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 0 ∧
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 5 ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = √5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissipation_mass
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot n)
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.jump 0 =
      3 * √5 / 5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_formula
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.type:
∀ (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  S ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot S 0 =
      -3 * √5 * CFDLean.Coordinates.area S / 10

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonpar.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonparallel_not_additive
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonpar.type:
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
    ![1, 1, 0] ≠
  CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
      ![1, 0, 0] +
    CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
      ![0, 1, 0]

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant ((1 / 2) • (a + b) - a) ((1 / 3) • (a + b + c) - a) ((1 / 4) • (a + b + c + d) - a) =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (b - a) (c - a) (d - a) / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle ((1 / 2) • (a + b)) ((1 / 3) • (a + b + c)) ((1 / 4) • (a + b + c + d)))
      (b - a) =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (b - a) (c - a) (d - a) / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points), CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter p = (1 / 4) • (p 0 + p 1 + p 2 + p 3)

CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.type:
∀ (a b : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.cross a b = ![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2, a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0]

CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1.type: ∀ (a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant a b c = CFDLean.dot a (CFDLean.MedianDual.cross b c)

CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left
CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left.type: ∀ (a : ℝ) (v w : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot (a • v) w = a * CFDLean.dot v w

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i = ![p 1, p 0, p 0, p 0] i

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i = p (i.succAbove 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k = (1 / 3) • (p i + p j + p k)

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i k j = CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i =
    ![CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 1) (p 2) (p 3), -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 0) (p 2) (p 3),
        CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 0) (p 1) (p 3), -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 0) (p 1) (p 2)]
      i

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (p i - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i) =
    -CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 2

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  ↑i ≠ ↑j → CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (p j - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i) = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_or_neg
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove 0)) (p (i.succAbove 1)) (p (i.succAbove 2)) ∨
    CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i =
      -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove 0)) (p (i.succAbove 1)) (p (i.succAbove 2))

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l r : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l • CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) r

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4), ∑ r, CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._simp_1_2
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, ∑ x ∈ s, r • f x = r • ∑ x ∈ s, f x

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 3 =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l •
      -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.MedianDual.Points

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_ident.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_identify
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_ident.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  ∑ f, ∑ r, CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 r = CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l * CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) = CFDLean.MedianDual.volume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l =
    (-1) ^
      ((((((if ↑i > ↑j then 1 else 0) + if ↑i > ↑k then 1 else 0) + if ↑i > ↑l then 1 else 0) +
            if ↑j > ↑k then 1 else 0) +
          if ↑j > ↑l then 1 else 0) +
        if ↑k > ↑l then 1 else 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs.type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin 4), |CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l| = 1

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq.type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l ^ 2 = 1

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i k j l = -CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j l k = -CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l

CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → p i + p j + p k + p l = p 0 + p 1 + p 2 + p 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid
CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid.type: (i j k l : Fin 4) → Decidable (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l)

CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._p.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._p.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  (decide (↑i ≠ ↑j) && decide (↑i ≠ ↑k ∧ ↑i ≠ ↑l ∧ ↑j ≠ ↑k ∧ ↑j ≠ ↑l ∧ ↑k ≠ ↑l)).Reflects
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l)

CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pai.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pair
CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pai.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 1 + CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i k j l 1 = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pai.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pair
CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pai.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 2 + CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j l k 2 = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume p i = CFDLean.MedianDual.volume p / 4

CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i =
    ∑ f,
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 0 +
        CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 3)

CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identificat.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identification
CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identificat.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i =
    ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j + ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p j i

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j =
    ∑ k, ∑ l, if CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l then CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j =
    (1 / 12) • (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_revers.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_reverse
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_revers.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p j i = -CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i i = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner =
    ∑ j, ∑ k, if CFDLean.MedianDual.valid owner j k opp then CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p owner j k opp 3 else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner = if ↑owner = ↑opp then 0 else (1 / 3) • CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p opp

CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure
CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j + ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p j i = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j = (1 / 2) • (p i + p j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_order
CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p ≠ 0 →
    0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p ∨ 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume ![p 0, p 2, p 1, p 3]

CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (p j - p i) (p k - p i) (p l - p i) =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l * CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p

CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l •
      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter p)

CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l) (p j - p i) = CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p = CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0) (p 3 - p 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume_swap12.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume_swap12
CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume_swap12.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points), CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume ![p 0, p 2, p 1, p 3] = -CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p

CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_one.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_one
CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_one.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), ∑ f, CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 1 = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_two.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_two
CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_two.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), ∑ f, CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 2 = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.swapJK_ne.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.swapJK_ne
CFDLean.MedianDual.swapJK_ne.type: ∀ (i : Fin 4) (f : CFDLean.MedianDual.VertexFlags i), CFDLean.MedianDual.swapJK i f ≠ f

CFDLean.MedianDual.swapKL_ne.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.swapKL_ne
CFDLean.MedianDual.swapKL_ne.type: ∀ (i : Fin 4) (f : CFDLean.MedianDual.VertexFlags i), CFDLean.MedianDual.swapKL i f ≠ f

CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle.eq_1.type: ∀ (a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle a b c = (1 / 2) • CFDLean.MedianDual.cross (b - a) (c - a)

CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle_cyclic.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle_cyclic
CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle_cyclic.type: ∀ (a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle b c a = CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle a b c

CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle_reverse.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle_reverse
CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle_reverse.type: ∀ (a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle a c b = -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle a b c

CFDLean.MedianDual.valid.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.valid.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.valid.eq_1.type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l = (↑i ≠ ↑j ∧ ↑i ≠ ↑k ∧ ↑i ≠ ↑l ∧ ↑j ≠ ↑k ∧ ↑j ≠ ↑l ∧ ↑k ≠ ↑l)

CFDLean.MedianDual.valid_swapJK.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.valid_swapJK
CFDLean.MedianDual.valid_swapJK.type: ∀ {i j k l : Fin 4}, CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i k j l

CFDLean.MedianDual.valid_swapKL.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.valid_swapKL
CFDLean.MedianDual.valid_swapKL.type: ∀ {i j k l : Fin 4}, CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j l k

CFDLean.MedianDual.vertexFlags_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.vertexFlags_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.vertexFlags_sum.type:
∀ (i : Fin 4) (f : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ a, f (↑a).1 (↑a).2.1 (↑a).2.2 = ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, if CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l then f j k l else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        M.B i k =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
              ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
            else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.beta_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.beta_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.beta_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    1 ≤ d → ∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.conforming_ba.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.conforming_balanced
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.conforming_ba.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool), M.Conforming bd → M.FacetBalanced bd

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.interior_zero.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.interior_zero
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.interior_zero.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    ∀ (P : Finset ι → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred P],
      (∑ p, if bd p = false ∧ P (M.facetNodes p) then M.areaVec p else 0) = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.card_facetNo.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.card_facetNodes
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.card_facetNo.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), (M.facetNodes p).card = d

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_side
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (p : C × Fin 4) (i0 i1 i2 : ι),
      ((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) = [i0, i1, i2] →
        M.facetVec p =
          (-(1 / 2) * CFDLean.Num.facetSide M p) • CFDLean.Num.cross3 (M.pos i1 - M.pos i0) (M.pos i2 - M.pos i0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_side2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (p : C × Fin 3) (i0 i1 : ι),
      ((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) = [i0, i1] →
        M.facetVec p = -CFDLean.Num.facetSide2 M p • CFDLean.Num.perp2 (M.pos i1 - M.pos i0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2) (o a b : Fin 3),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -1 else 1) •
          CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.lagrange2.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.lagrange2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.lagrange2.type:
∀ (u w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec 2),
  CFDLean.Num.dot g w • CFDLean.Num.perp2 u - CFDLean.Num.dot g u • CFDLean.Num.perp2 w =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 u) w • g

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst : LinearOrder ι] [Fintype C] (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2)
  (p : C × Fin 3) (i0 i1 : ι),
  ((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) = [i0, i1] →
    ∃ a b, [p.2, a, b].Nodup ∧ (M.vert p.1) a = i0 ∧ (M.vert p.1) b = i1

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals2._sim.type:
∀ {F : Sort u_1} {α : Sort u_2} {β : Sort u_3} [inst : FunLike F α β] [i : EmbeddingLike F α β] (f : F) {x y : α},
  (f x = f y) = (x = y)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst : LinearOrder ι] [Fintype C] (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3)
  (p : C × Fin 4) (i0 i1 i2 : ι),
  ((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) = [i0, i1, i2] →
    ∃ a b c, [p.2, a, b, c].Nodup ∧ (M.vert p.1) a = i0 ∧ (M.vert p.1) b = i1 ∧ (M.vert p.1) c = i2

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._sim.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._sim.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.locals3._sim.type:
∀ {F : Sort u_1} {α : Sort u_2} {β : Sort u_3} [inst : FunLike F α β] [i : EmbeddingLike F α β] (f : F) {x y : α},
  (f x = f y) = (x = y)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNodes
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (p : C × Fin (d + 1)) (i : ι), i ∈ M.facetNodes p ↔ ∃ a, a ≠ p.2 ∧ (M.vert p.1) a = i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNodes._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α ↪ β} {s : Finset α} {b : β}, (b ∈ Finset.map f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNodes._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {s : Finset α}, (a ∈ s.erase b) = (a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNodes._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.mem_facetNod.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.simplex_x.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.simplex_x
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.simplex_x.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C)
  (e : Fin (d + 1)), (M.simplex T).x e = M.pos ((M.vert T) e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.type:
∀ (p : Fin 3 → CFDLean.Num.Vec 2) (o a b : Fin 3),
  [o, a, b].Nodup →
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (p b - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (p 1 - p 0)) (p 2 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (p b - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        -CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (p 1 - p 0)) (p 2 - p 0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dl_sub.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dl_sub
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dl_sub.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x y z : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (x - y) z = CFDLean.Num.dot x z - CFDLean.Num.dot y z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dr_smul.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dr_smul
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dr_smul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (x y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (c : ℝ), CFDLean.Num.dot x (c • y) = c * CFDLean.Num.dot x y

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dr_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dr_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.dr_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Q : Type} (s : Finset Q) (x : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (f : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot x (∑ q ∈ s, f q) = ∑ q ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.dot x (f q)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.mv_sum_l.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.mv_sum_l
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.mv_sum_l.type:
∀ {κ ι Q : Type} [Fintype κ] [inst : Fintype ι] (s : Finset Q) (A : Q → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (y : ι → ℝ),
  (∑ k ∈ s, A k).mulVec y = ∑ k ∈ s, (A k).mulVec y

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.mv_sum_r.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.mv_sum_r
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.mv_sum_r.type:
∀ {κ ι Q : Type} [Fintype κ] [inst : Fintype ι] (s : Finset Q) (A : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (f : Q → ι → ℝ),
  A.mulVec (∑ q ∈ s, f q) = ∑ q ∈ s, A.mulVec (f q)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_smul.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_smul
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_smul.type: ∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y : κ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), CFDLean.Num.pairF (c • x) y = c * CFDLean.Num.pairF x y

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_sub.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_sub
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_sub.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (x - y) z = CFDLean.Num.pairF x z - CFDLean.Num.pairF y z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pl_sum.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {Q : Type} (s : Finset Q) (f : Q → κ → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (∑ q ∈ s, f q) y = ∑ q ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (f q) y

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_add.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_add
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_add.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (y + z) = CFDLean.Num.pairF x y + CFDLean.Num.pairF x z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_smul.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_smul
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_smul.type: ∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y : κ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), CFDLean.Num.pairF x (c • y) = c * CFDLean.Num.pairF x y

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_sub.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_sub
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_sub.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] (x y z : κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (y - z) = CFDLean.Num.pairF x y - CFDLean.Num.pairF x z

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.pr_sum.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {Q : Type} (s : Finset Q) (x : κ → ℝ) (f : Q → κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF x (∑ q ∈ s, f q) = ∑ q ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF x (f q)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.regroup.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.regroup
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Cl8.regroup.type:
∀ {Q P : Type} [inst : Fintype Q] [inst_1 : Fintype P] [inst_2 : DecidableEq P] {d : ℕ} (fq : Q → P) (f : Q → ℝ)
  (v : P → CFDLean.Num.Vec d), ∑ q, f q • v (fq q) = ∑ p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then f q else 0) • v p

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι),
  M.B i k = ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T • M.m T • (M.g T a + M.g T b) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq._abel_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq._abel_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq._abel_.type: ∀ {ι C : Type} {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (a b : Fin (d + 1)), M.g T b + M.g T a = M.g T a + M.g T b

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq._simp_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq._simp_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identity
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (i k : ι),
  ((↑d * (↑d + 1)) • ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.m T • (M.g T a + M.g T b) else 0) =
    (if i = k then 2 else 1) • ∑ o, if i ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o) ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o) then M.facetVec (T, o) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identity._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C)
  (a o : Fin (d + 1)), ((M.vert T) a ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o)) = (a ≠ o)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identity._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.closed_of_f.type:

  M.FacetPaired i → M.Closed i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.dot_smul_le.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.dot_smul_left'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.dot_smul_le.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (c • u) v = c * CFDLean.Num.dot u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.faceVector_.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.faceVector_eq_grad
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.faceVector_.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p →
    ∀ (j : Fin 4),
      CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p j =
        -(3 * (CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).vol) • (CFDLean.Num.simplexOfPoints p).grad j

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      (∀ (o : M.Occurrence), M.faceCount (M.faceID o) = 1 → i ∉ M.faceID o) → (CFDLean.Num.ofMeshData M).FacetPaired i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired._proof_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (o : M.Occurrence),
  (M.faceOccurrences (M.faceID o)).card ≠ 1 →
    0 < (M.faceOccurrences (M.faceID o)).card → ¬1 < (M.faceOccurrences (M.faceID o)).card → False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired._proof_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (o : M.Occurrence),
  2 + 1 ≤ (M.faceOccurrences (M.faceID o)).card → (M.faceOccurrences (M.faceID o)).card ≤ 2 → False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetPaired.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetVec_of.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetVec_ofMeshData
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facetVec_of.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (o : M.Occurrence),
  (CFDLean.Num.ofMeshData M).facetVec o = M.faceArea o

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facet_sum.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facet_sum
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facet_sum.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d), ∑ o, T.facet o = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facet_sum._.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facet_sum._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.facet_sum._.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, ∑ x ∈ s, r • f x = r • ∑ x ∈ s, f x

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNodes
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.type:

  (i : ι), i ∈ M.facetNodes p ↔ ∃ a, a ≠ p.2 ∧ (M.vert p.1) a = i

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNodes._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α ↪ β} {s : Finset α} {b : β}, (b ∈ Finset.map f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNodes._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {s : Finset α}, (a ∈ s.erase b) = (a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ s)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNodes._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.mem_facetNo.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.not_mem_fac.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.not_mem_facetNodes
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.not_mem_fac.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (o : Fin (d + 1))
