CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [inst_2 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (w : S → κ → ℝ)
  (ψ : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → ℝ),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = Fec b a y) →
    (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.pairF (w b - w a) (Fec a b y) = CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ b - ψ a) y) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        (∀ (q : Q), w (ut q) = ∑ k, φ q k • w (u k)) →
          let beta := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • N q;
          let b := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + Fs q);
          ∑ i, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u i)) (beta i) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (u i)) (b i)) =
              ∑ q, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (ut q)) (N q) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (ut q)) (Fs q)) ∧
            ∑ i, b i = ∑ q, Fs q

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._a.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._abel_1_2
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._a.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → ℝ) (q : Q),
  ∑ x, φ q x • Fec (ut q) (u x) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + Fs q = Fs q

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._s.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._s.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_5} {M : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] {f : ι → R} {s : Finset ι} {x : M}, ∑ i ∈ s, f i • x = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) • x

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ)
  (phys : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (U : S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a b : S), IsLinearMap ℝ (Fec a b)) →
    (∀ (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec U U y = phys U y) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        (∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = -∑ k, n i k) →
          let b := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec U U (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec U U (N q) + phys U (N q));
          ∀ (i : ι), -∑ k, Fec U U (n i k) - b i = 0

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream._abel_1_4
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.type:
∀ (ι S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (U : S)
  (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι), -∑ k, Fec U U (n i k) - -∑ k, Fec U U (n i k) = 0

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_5} {M : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] {f : ι → R} {s : Finset ι} {x : M}, ∑ i ∈ s, f i • x = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) • x

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.type:
∀ {F : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} {X : Type u_10} {Y : Type u_11} [inst : SMul M X] [inst_1 : SMul M Y]
  [inst_2 : FunLike F X Y] [MulActionHomClass F M X Y] (f : F) (c : M) (x : X), c • f x = f (c • x)

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream._simp_1_3

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ)
  (Fl : S → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = ((1 / 2) • (Fl a + Fl b)).mulVec y) →
    (∀ (q : Q), Fl (ut q) = ∑ k, φ q k • Fl (u k)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        let beta := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • N q;
        let b := fun i =>
          ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + (Fl (ut q)).mulVec (N q));
        ∀ (i : ι), b i = (1 / 2) • ((Fl (u i)).mulVec (beta i) + ∑ k, (Fl (u k)).mulVec (∑ q, (φ q i * φ q k) • N q))

CFDLean.Num.stdWeight.name: CFDLean.Num.stdWeight
CFDLean.Num.stdWeight.type: {ι : Type} → [DecidableEq ι] → ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ

CFDLean.Num.stdWeight.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Num.stdWeight.congr_simp
CFDLean.Num.stdWeight.congr_simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type} {inst : DecidableEq ι} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (d d_1 : ℕ),
  d = d_1 →
    ∀ (i i_1 : ι), i = i_1 → ∀ (j j_1 : ι), j = j_1 → CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j = CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d_1 i_1 j_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux..name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux..type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) S)

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePress.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePress.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x)

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x = (x 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x) / x 0

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coo.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coordinateFlux
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coo.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 → HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ n) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n) x

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_int.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_integratedFlux
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_int.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    S ≠ 0 →
      HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) x

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_normalMomentum
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  HasFDerivAt (fun y => CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y).momentum n)
    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) x

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_normalVelocity
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y).momentum n / y 0)
      ((1 / x 0) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n) x

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) x

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_10
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_4
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_5
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_6
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_7
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_8
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure._simp_1_9
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) +
          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n]

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (a : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x fun i => a * n i) = a • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n =
    CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n -
      CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n =
    n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
      n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x =
    (γ - 1) •
      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
              CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
        (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formula
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = (γ - 1) * (x 4 - (x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) / (2 * x 0))

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i = (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i / x 0

CFDLean.Primitive.casesOn.name: CFDLean.Primitive.casesOn
CFDLean.Primitive.casesOn.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Primitive d → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.Primitive d) →
      ((density : ℝ) →
          (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) →
            (pressure : ℝ) → motive { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure }) →
        motive t

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ → CFDLean.Primitive d

CFDLean.Primitive.mk._flat_ctor.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk._flat_ctor
CFDLean.Primitive.mk._flat_ctor.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ → CFDLean.Primitive d

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.inj.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk.inj
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.inj.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {density : ℝ} {velocity : CFDLean.Vector d} {pressure density_1 : ℝ} {velocity_1 : CFDLean.Vector d}
  {pressure_1 : ℝ},
  { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure } =
      { density := density_1, velocity := velocity_1, pressure := pressure_1 } →
    density = density_1 ∧ velocity = velocity_1 ∧ pressure = pressure_1

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk.injEq
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.injEq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) (pressure density_1 : ℝ) (velocity_1 : CFDLean.Vector d)
  (pressure_1 : ℝ),
  ({ density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure } =
      { density := density_1, velocity := velocity_1, pressure := pressure_1 }) =
    (density = density_1 ∧ velocity = velocity_1 ∧ pressure = pressure_1)

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk.noConfusion
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.noConfusion.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {density : ℝ} →
      {velocity : CFDLean.Vector d} →
        {pressure density' : ℝ} →
          {velocity' : CFDLean.Vector d} →
            {pressure' : ℝ} →
              { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure } =
                  { density := density', velocity := velocity', pressure := pressure' } →
                (density = density' → velocity ≍ velocity' → pressure = pressure' → P) → P

CFDLean.Primitive.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: CFDLean.Primitive.mk.sizeOf_spec
CFDLean.Primitive.mk.sizeOf_spec.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) (pressure : ℝ),
  sizeOf { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure } = 1 + sizeOf density + sizeOf pressure

CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusion.name: CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusion
CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusion.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {d : ℕ} →
    {t : CFDLean.Primitive d} →
      {d' : ℕ} → {t' : CFDLean.Primitive d'} → d = d' → t ≍ t' → CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType P t t'

CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType.name: CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType
CFDLean.Primitive.noConfusionType.type: Sort u → {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Primitive d → {d' : ℕ} → CFDLean.Primitive d' → Sort u

CFDLean.Primitive.rec.name: CFDLean.Primitive.rec
CFDLean.Primitive.rec.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Primitive d → Sort u} →
    ((density : ℝ) →
        (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) →
          (pressure : ℝ) → motive { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure }) →
      (t : CFDLean.Primitive d) → motive t

CFDLean.Primitive.recOn.name: CFDLean.Primitive.recOn
CFDLean.Primitive.recOn.type:
{d : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.Primitive d → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.Primitive d) →
      ((density : ℝ) →
          (velocity : CFDLean.Vector d) →
            (pressure : ℝ) → motive { density := density, velocity := velocity, pressure := pressure }) →
        motive t

CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.name: CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative
CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Primitive d → CFDLean.Conservative d

CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.eq_1
CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W =
    { density := W.density, momentum := fun i => W.density * W.velocity i,
      energy := W.pressure / (γ - 1) + W.density * CFDLean.squareSum W.velocity / 2 }

CFDLean.Roe.B.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.B.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.B.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.B γ z =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![(2 * z 0) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0,
        z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1,
        z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2,
        z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3,
        (1 / γ) •
          (z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
            (γ - 1) •
              (z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3))]

CFDLean.Roe.B_bijective.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_bijective
CFDLean.Roe.B_bijective.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), γ ≠ 0 → z 0 ≠ 0 → Function.Bijective ⇑(CFDLean.Roe.B γ z)

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 → z 0 ≠ 0 → ∀ (v : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), (CFDLean.Roe.B γ z) ((CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ z) v) = v

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_3.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_3.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_4.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_4.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_5.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_5.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_6.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_6.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_7.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_7
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_7.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_8.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_8
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_8.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_9.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_9
CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB._simp_1_9.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.C.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.C.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.C.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![(CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 +
          z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n +
          n 0 • CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z,
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z,
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z,
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
          z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n = ↑(CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A_eq_shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A_eq_shift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A_eq_shift.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) v = CFDLean.dot u n • v + (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c =
    |CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 0| • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c +
        |CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 1| • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c +
      |CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 2| • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_repr.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_representation
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_repr.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (bas : Module.Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c =
              ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_on_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_on_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_on_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c μ : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          v ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) v = μ • v → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c) v = |μ| • v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H (-n) c = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic.eq_1.type:
∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (s : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H + s • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (s : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    s ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s) =
        (CFDLean.dot u n + s) • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic_ne_zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic_ne_zero
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic_ne_zero.type: ∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (s : ℝ), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s ≠ 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b.eq_1.type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n =
    ↑(CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_energy.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_energy
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.energy γ) = 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_shift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_shift.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v) = (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_vb.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_vb
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_vb.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H) = 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_vp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_vp
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b_vp.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n) = CFDLean.dot n n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.complete_eigenbasis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.complete_eigenbasis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.complete_eigenbasis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      0 < c →
        γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
          ∃ bas,
            ∀ (j : Fin 5), ∃ i, (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (bas j) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i • bas j

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact.eq_1.type: ∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u = ![1, u 0, u 1, u 2, CFDLean.squareSum u / 2]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u) = CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decompos.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decomposition
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decompos.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ v ∈ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n),
        ∃ t, CFDLean.dot t n = 0 ∧ v = v 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimensio.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimension
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimensio.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 → Module.finrank ℝ ↥((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n)) = 3

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimensio.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimension._proof_1_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimensio.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  2 + Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n).ker = 5 →
    ¬Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n).ker = 3 → False

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_eq_kerne.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_eq_kernel
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_eq_kerne.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n) = (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n).ker

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_span
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (tb : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)),
        Submodule.span ℝ ({CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u} ∪ Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u ↑(tb i)) =
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal.type: {ι : Type u_1} → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ι → ℝ

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal._proof_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal._proof_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal._proof_1.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a x y : ι → ℝ), (fun i => a i * (x + y) i) = (fun i => a i * x i) + fun i => a i * y i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal._proof_2.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal._proof_2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal._proof_2.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ), (fun i => a i * (r • x) i) = (RingHom.id ℝ) r • fun i => a i * x i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal.eq_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ι → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal a = { toFun := fun x i => a i * x i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n =
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y) n
      (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dot_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dot_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dot_reverse.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot u (-n) = -CFDLean.dot u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u =
    ↑((γ - 1) •
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
            (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
              u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
          (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3), γ - 1 ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.energy γ) = 1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v) =
    (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H) = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n) = 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensio.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensions
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensio.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ ↥((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i)) =
              ![1, 3, 1] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 → ⨆ i, (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i) = ⊤

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenvalue_exhausti.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenvalue_exhaustive
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenvalue_exhausti.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c μ : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        v ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) v = μ • v → ∃ i, μ = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.exists_tangent_basi.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.exists_tangent_basis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.exists_tangent_basi.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c =
    (1 / (2 * c ^ 2)) • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2 - c • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_apply
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c) v =
          (((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v - c * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) / (2 * c ^ 2)) •
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n (-c)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_range
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 → LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c) = ℝ ∙ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n (-c)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier.eq_1.type:
∀ (c s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier c s j =
    ![(s ^ 2 - c * s) / (2 * c ^ 2), 1 - s ^ 2 / c ^ 2, (s ^ 2 + c * s) / (2 * c ^ 2)] j

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier_offset.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier_offset
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier_offset.type:
∀ (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (i j : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier c (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i) j = if i = j then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_1.type: ∀ (n t s : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot (t + s) n = CFDLean.dot t n + CFDLean.dot s n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_2.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_2.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (r : ℝ) (t : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot (r • t) n = (RingHom.id ℝ) r • CFDLean.dot t n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal_surjective.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal_surjective
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal_surjective.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → Function.Surjective ⇑(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset.eq_1.type: ∀ (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i = ![-c, 0, c] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c =
    (1 / (2 * c ^ 2)) • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2 + c • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_apply
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c) v =
          (((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v + c * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) / (2 * c ^ 2)) •
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_range
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 → LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c) = ℝ ∙ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Fin 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i =
    ![CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c, CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c, CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_algebra.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_algebra
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_algebra.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i j : Fin 3),
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i * CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c j =
            if i = j then CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i else 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c s : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v = s • v →
    ∀ (j : Fin 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c j) v = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier c s j • v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_shift_.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_shift_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_shift_.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i • v →
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c j) v = if i = j then v else 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_range
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i : Fin 3),
          LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) =
            (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H (-n) c i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i.rev

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c = 1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.type:
∀ (f : Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (r : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (a : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → ℝ),
  (∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E), f v = a v • r) → f r = r → LinearMap.range f = ℝ ∙ r

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Fin 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i =
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y) n
      (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n =
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y) n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (bas : Module.Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n =
                ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (μ : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
            v ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) v = μ • v → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) v = |μ| • v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (-n) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∃ bas,
            ∀ (j : Fin 5),
              ∃ i, (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas j) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i • bas j

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tangent_span
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
      ∀ (tb : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)),
        Submodule.span ℝ
            ({CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)} ∪
              Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ↑(tb i)) =
          Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ^ 3 =
            CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ
                ↥(Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)) =
              ![1, 3, 1] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          (∀ (s : ℝ),
              s = -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∨ s = CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
                (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) =
                  (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n + s) •
                    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) ∧
            (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) =
                CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ∧
              ∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
                CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
                  (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t) =
                    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algebra
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i j : Fin 3),
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i * CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n j =
              if i = j then CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i else 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranges
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) =
              Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ ↥(LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i)) = ![1, 3, 1] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y (-n) i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i.rev

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2 =
          1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomposition
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) =
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 +
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y (-n) i = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i.rev

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ y x n i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.type: ∀ (u t : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t = ![0, t 0, t 1, t 2, CFDLean.dot u t]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1.type:
∀ (u t s : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (t + s) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u s

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2.type:
∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (r : ℝ) (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (r • t) = (RingHom.id ℝ) r • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t) = CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n - CFDLean.dot u n • 1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v =
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H +
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v) =
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2) v =
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H +
            (c ^ 2 * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (s : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    s ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s) =
        s • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 3 = c ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        0 < CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∧
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 =
            (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposition
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n =
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c +
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c +
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1.type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i = CFDLean.dot u n + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → Function.Injective (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_reverse.type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u (-n) c i = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i.rev

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangentBasis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangentBasis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangentBasis.type: (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) → CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n) = 2

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension._.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension._proof_1_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension._.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 + Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal n).ker = 3 →
    ¬Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal n).ker = 2 → False

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb.eq_1.type: ∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H = ![1, u 0, u 1, u 2, H]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp.eq_1.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n = ![0, n 0, n 1, n 2, CFDLean.dot u n]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E →ₗ[ℝ] Fin 2 → ℝ

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n = LinearMap.pi ![CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n, CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → γ - 1 ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective ⇑(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c = 1 - (1 / c ^ 2) • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2

CFDLean.Roe.area_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.area_scale
CFDLean.Roe.area_scale.type: ∀ (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3), 0 ≤ a → (CFDLean.Coordinates.area fun i => a * S i) = a * CFDLean.Coordinates.area S

CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1.type:
∀ (r : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.assemble r =
    CFDLean.Roe.embed 0 ∘SL r 0 + CFDLean.Roe.embed 1 ∘SL r 1 + CFDLean.Roe.embed 2 ∘SL r 2 +
        CFDLean.Roe.embed 3 ∘SL r 3 +
      CFDLean.Roe.embed 4 ∘SL r 4

CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.name: CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi
CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.type: ∀ (r : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] ℝ), CFDLean.Roe.assemble r = ContinuousLinearMap.pi r

CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y =
    CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x +
      CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ y

CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.type:
∀ (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y i =
    CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i +
      CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i

CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt
CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (p : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates × CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < p.1 0 →
    0 < p.2 0 → ContinuousAt (fun q => (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity q.1 q.2, CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ q.1 q.2)) p

CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal
CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x x = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x x = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x

CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap
CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y

CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg.name: CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg
CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ (-S) x = -CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x

CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale
CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ (fun i => a * S i) x = a • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x

CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg.name: CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg
CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (-x) =
    { density := -(CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).density,
      momentum := fun i => -(CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i,
      energy := -(CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale
CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale.type:
∀ (a : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (a • x) =
    { density := a * (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).density,
      momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i,
      energy := a * (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero
CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero.type: CFDLean.Coordinates.decode 0 = { density := 0, momentum := fun x => 0, energy := 0 }

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        0 ≤ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 →
          0 ≤ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 →
            0 ≤ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 ≤ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 ≤ 0 →
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 ≤ 0 →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = -↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ≤ CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right.type:

      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n ≤ -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = -↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_zero_of_matrix_z.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_zero_of_matrix_zero
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_zero_of_matrix_z.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →

          ∀ (v : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
            (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) v = 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) v = 0

CFDLean.Roe.embed.eq_1.type: ∀ (i : Fin 5), CFDLean.Roe.embed i = ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j => if j = i then ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ else 0

CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S • CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x) =

CFDLean.Roe.inverseB.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.inverseB.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.inverseB.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ z =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![(1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0,
        (1 / z 0) •
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 - z 1 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        (1 / z 0) •
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 - z 2 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        (1 / z 0) •
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 - z 3 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        (1 / z 0) •
          (γ • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 - z 4 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 -
            (γ - 1) •
              (z 1 •
                    (1 / z 0) •
                      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 -
                        z 1 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
                  z 2 •
                    (1 / z 0) •
                      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 -
                        z 2 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
                z 3 •
                  (1 / z 0) •
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 -
                      z 3 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)))]

  CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ V U (-S) =
    { density := -(CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).density,
      momentum := fun i => -(CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).momentum i,
      energy := -(CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_scale
CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 ≤ a →
    (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V fun i => a * S i) =
      { density := a * (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).density,
        momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).momentum i,
        energy := a * (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_left.type:

  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        S ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) ≤
              CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S) →
            CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S = CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_right.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        S ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S) ≤
              -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) →
            CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S = CFDLean.physicalFlux γ V S

CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H n =
    CFDLean.Roe.assemble
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            u 0 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 0 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            u 1 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 1 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            u 2 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 2 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
              (γ - 1) •
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                    (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                      u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                  (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)) +
          H • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)]

CFDLean.Roe.operator_B.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_B
CFDLean.Roe.operator_B.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    z 0 ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.operator γ (fun i => z ↑↑i.succ / z 0) (z 4 / z 0) n ∘SL CFDLean.Roe.B γ z = CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z

CFDLean.Roe.operator_continuous.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_continuous
CFDLean.Roe.operator_continuous.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), Continuous fun p => CFDLean.Roe.operator γ p.1 p.2 n

CFDLean.Roe.operator_physical.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_physical
CFDLean.Roe.operator_physical.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.operator γ (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x) n =
    CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n

CFDLean.Roe.operator_smul.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_smul
CFDLean.Roe.operator_smul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H a : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  (CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H fun i => a * n i) = a • CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H n

CFDLean.Roe.parameter.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.parameter.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x =
    ![CFDLean.Roe.root x, CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0,
      CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1,
      CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2,
      CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x]

CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n z =
    ![z 0 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z,
      z 1 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z + CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z * n 0,
      z 2 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z + CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z * n 1,
      z 3 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z + CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z * n 2,
      z 4 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z]

CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z = (γ - 1) / γ * (z 0 * z 4 - (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 + z 3 ^ 2) / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.parameterState.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameterState.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.parameterState.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ z =
    ![z 0 ^ 2, z 0 * z 1, z 0 * z 2, z 0 * z 3, (z 0 * z 4 + (γ - 1) / 2 * (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 + z 3 ^ 2)) / γ]

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    0 < x 0 → CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n (CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x) = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ n x

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 → 0 < x 0 → CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ (CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x) = x

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_3.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_3.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_4.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_4.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_5.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_5
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_5.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_6.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_6
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_6.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_7.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_7
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_7.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state._simp_1_8.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False
