CFDLean.Roe.positivity_counterexample.name: CFDLean.Roe.positivity_counterexample
CFDLean.Roe.positivity_counterexample.type:
CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible 2 CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft ∧
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible 2 CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight ∧
    0 <
        CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
          (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight) ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.witnessIntermediate.density < 0

CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z =
    ((γ - 1) / γ) •
      (z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
        (z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
          z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3))

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S =
    if S = 0 then 0
    else
      (1 / 2) • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y) -
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S / 2) •
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x)

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_o.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_of_zero
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_o.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x) = 0 →
            CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S =
              (1 / 2) • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y)

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_consisten.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_consistency
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_consisten.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x x S = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ y x (-S) = -CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_scale
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 ≤ a → (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y fun i => a * S i) = a • CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_upwind_le.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_upwind_left
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_upwind_le.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ≤
              CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S) →
            CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_upwind_ri.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_upwind_right
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_upwind_ri.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S) ≤
              -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
            CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_zero
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_zero.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y 0 = 0

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix.type:
ℝ →
  CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →
    CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →
      CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    0 < x 0 →
      0 < y 0 →
        CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n ∘SL CFDLean.Roe.B γ (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y) =
          CFDLean.Roe.C γ n (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y)

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n =
          CFDLean.Roe.C γ n (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y) ∘SL CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y)

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousAt.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousAt
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousAt.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (p : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates × CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < p.1 0 → 0 < p.2 0 → ContinuousAt (fun q => CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ q.1 q.2 n) p

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousOn.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousOn
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousOn.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ContinuousOn (fun q => CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ q.1 q.2 n)
    {p |
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode p.1) ∧
        CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode p.2)}

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_diagonal.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_diagonal
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_diagonal.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 < x 0 → CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x x n = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_equal_state_limit.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_equal_state_limit
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_equal_state_limit.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun p => CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ p.1 p.2 n) (nhds (x, x))
      (nhds (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n))

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_swap
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.root_sum_pos.name: CFDLean.Roe.root_sum_pos
CFDLean.Roe.root_sum_pos.type: ∀ (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), 0 < x 0 → 0 < y 0 → 0 < CFDLean.Roe.root x + CFDLean.Roe.root y

CFDLean.Roe.secant_identity.name: CFDLean.Roe.secant_identity
CFDLean.Roe.secant_identity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (y - x) =
          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ n y - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ n x

CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed.eq_1.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y = √(CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)

CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_pos.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_pos
CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_pos.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) → 0 < CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y

CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_sq.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_sq
CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_sq.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 = CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y

CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
    (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare_pos.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare_pos
CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare_pos.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) → 0 < CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y

CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump.name: CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump
CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z t : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ t - CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ z = (CFDLean.Roe.B γ fun i => (z i + t i) / 2) (t - z)

CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale
CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale.type:
∀ (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 < a → S ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal fun i => a * S i) = CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S

CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_2.name: CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_2.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_3.name: CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_3.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_4.name: CFDLean.Roe.unitNormal_scale._simp_1_4

CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.name: CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity
CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    0 < y 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
        CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x +
            CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y +
          (γ - 1) / 2 * CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.weight y x *
            CFDLean.squareSum fun i => CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i

CFDLean.Roe.weighted_square.name: CFDLean.Roe.weighted_square
CFDLean.Roe.weighted_square.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (v w : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  a + b = 1 →
    (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => a * v i + b * w i) =
      a * CFDLean.squareSum v + b * CFDLean.squareSum w - a * b * CFDLean.squareSum fun i => w i - v i

        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight) =

      (fun x => CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoSteps ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap 0 3)) x))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual
        (CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoCells.interfaces.reindex (Equiv.swap 0 3)
          (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Time.Controls.edge01 CFDLean.Time.Controls.edge03)
          (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen))
        2
        (fun x =>
          CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoCells CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds
            ((Equiv.symm
                (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen))
              x))
        (fun x =>
          CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoCells CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoData
            ((Equiv.symm
                (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen))
              x))
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.varyingStates ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap 0 3)) x))
        (fun x =>
          CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoCells.edgeArea
            ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Time.Controls.edge01 CFDLean.Time.Controls.edge03)) x))
        fun x =>
        CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoCells.boundaryArea
          ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoWall CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoOpen))
            x))
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.varyingStates ((Equiv.symm (Equiv.swap 0 3)) x))
      ((Equiv.swap 0 3) i) =
    CFDLean.Time.meshStep CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoCells 2 CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.twoKinds
      CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoData CFDLean.Time.Controls.twoSteps CFDLean.Boundary.AssemblyControls.varyingStates i

      (N → ℝ) → (N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → N → CFDLean.Conservative 3

CFDLean.Time.heldStep.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Time.heldStep.eq_1
CFDLean.Time.heldStep.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} (used : N → Prop) (v τ : N → ℝ) (R : N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Time.heldStep used v τ R U i = if used i then CFDLean.Time.euler (v i) (τ i) (R i) (U i) else U i

CFDLean.Time.held_amount.name: CFDLean.Time.held_amount
CFDLean.Time.held_amount.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype N] (used : N → Prop) (v τ : N → ℝ) (R : N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  (∀ (i : N), used i → v i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (i : N), ¬used i → R i = 0) →
      CFDLean.Time.amount v (CFDLean.Time.heldStep used v τ R U) = CFDLean.Time.amount v U - ∑ i, τ i • R i

CFDLean.Time.held_reindex.name: CFDLean.Time.held_reindex
CFDLean.Time.held_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {N' : Type u_2} (n : N ≃ N') (used : N → Prop) (v τ : N → ℝ)
  (R : N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Time.heldStep (fun x => used (n.symm x)) (fun x => v (n.symm x)) (fun x => τ (n.symm x))
      (fun x => R (n.symm x)) (fun x => U (n.symm x)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Time.heldStep used v τ R U i

CFDLean.Time.held_unused.name: CFDLean.Time.held_unused
CFDLean.Time.held_unused.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} (used : N → Prop) (v τ : N → ℝ) (R : N → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : N), ¬used i → CFDLean.Time.heldStep used v τ R U i = U i

CFDLean.Time.held_zero_residual.name: CFDLean.Time.held_zero_residual
CFDLean.Time.held_zero_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} (used : N → Prop) (v τ : N → ℝ) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Time.heldStep used v τ (fun x => 0) U i = U i

CFDLean.Time.meshStep.name: CFDLean.Time.meshStep
CFDLean.Time.meshStep.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m →
    ℝ →
      (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) →
        (Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) →
          (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3

CFDLean.Time.meshStep.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Time.meshStep.eq_1
CFDLean.Time.meshStep.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U =
    CFDLean.Time.heldStep M.Used M.dualVolume τ (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U) U

CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_change.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_change
CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_change.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U - ∑ i, τ i • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i

CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_used.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_used
CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_used.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U = ∑ i with M.Used i, M.dualVolume i • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → τ i = dt) →
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
      CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U - dt • ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b

CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance_physica.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance_physical
CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance_physica.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ),
  1 < γ →
    ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ)
      (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
      0 ≤ dt →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (U i)) →
          (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
              CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)) →
            (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → τ i = dt) →
              CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
                CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U - dt • ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b

CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_state.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_state
CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_state.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ),
      1 < γ →
        ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → 0 ≤ τ i) →
            ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
              CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b) = 0) →
                  (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                      CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                        CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = U) →
                    ∀ (i : Fin n), CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ (fun x => U) i = U

CFDLean.Time.mesh_component_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_component_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_component_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ) (j : Fin 5),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i) j =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) j - dt * ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b j

CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).energy =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).energy -
      dt *
        ∑ b,
          if CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
              (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b) 4
          else 0

CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U -
      (∑ e,
          (τ (M.interfaces.tail e) - τ (M.interfaces.head e)) •
            CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e +
        ∑ b, τ (M.interfaces.owner b) • CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance_physical.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance_physical
CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance_physical.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ),
  1 < γ →
    ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → 0 ≤ τ i) →
        ∀ (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (U i)) →
            (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)) →
              CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
                CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U -
                  (∑ e,
                      (τ (M.interfaces.tail e) - τ (M.interfaces.head e)) •
                        CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e +
                    ∑ b, τ (M.interfaces.owner b) • CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_mass_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_mass_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_mass_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).density =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).density -
      dt *
        ∑ b,
          if CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
              (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b) 0
          else 0

CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).momentum j =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).momentum j -
      dt *
        ∑ b,
          if CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
            (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
                  (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
                    (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b))).momentum
              j
          else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) * M.boundaryArea b j

CFDLean.Time.mesh_point_amount.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_point_amount
CFDLean.Time.mesh_point_amount.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    M.dualVolume i • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i) =
      M.dualVolume i • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) - τ i • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i

CFDLean.Time.mesh_residual_unused.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_residual_unused
CFDLean.Time.mesh_residual_unused.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  ¬M.Used i → CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i = 0

CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Time.heldStep (fun x => M.Used (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.dualVolume (nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => τ (nodeEq.symm x))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
        (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =
    CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i

CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_unused.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_unused
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_unused.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  ¬M.Used i → CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i = U i

CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i =
      CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) - (τ i / M.dualVolume i) • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_energy.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_energy
CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_energy.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  (∀ (b : M.Boundary), CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe) →
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).energy = ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).energy

CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_mass.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_mass
CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_mass.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  (∀ (b : M.Boundary), CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe) →
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).density =
      ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).density

CFDLean.Time.mesh_used_volume_pos.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_used_volume_pos
CFDLean.Time.mesh_used_volume_pos.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (i : Fin n), M.Used i → 0 < M.dualVolume i

CFDLean.Time.mesh_zero_step.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_zero_step
CFDLean.Time.mesh_zero_step.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => 0) U i = U i

CFDLean.Time.owner_used.name: CFDLean.Time.owner_used
CFDLean.Time.owner_used.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), M.Used (M.interfaces.owner b)

CFDLean.Time.tail_used.name: CFDLean.Time.tail_used
CFDLean.Time.tail_used.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (e : M.Edge), M.Used (M.interfaces.tail e)

CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.name: CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual
CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (τ : N → ℝ)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, τ i • CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = ∑ e, (τ (m.tail e) - τ (m.head e)) • f e + ∑ b, τ (m.owner b) • g b

CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual._simp_1_1.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] (r s : R)
  (y : M), r • y - s • y = (r - s) • y

CFDLean.admissible_exists.name: CFDLean.admissible_exists
CFDLean.admissible_exists.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ), 1 < γ → ∃ U, CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U

CFDLean.admissible_iff_internalEnergy_po.name: CFDLean.admissible_iff_internalEnergy_pos
CFDLean.admissible_iff_internalEnergy_po.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  1 < γ →
    (CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U ↔ 0 < U.density ∧ CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum / (2 * U.density) < U.energy)

CFDLean.conservative_admissible_toPrimit.name: CFDLean.conservative_admissible_toPrimitive
CFDLean.conservative_admissible_toPrimit.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ U).Admissible

CFDLean.conservative_roundTrip.name: CFDLean.conservative_roundTrip
CFDLean.conservative_roundTrip.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  γ ≠ 1 → U.density ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ U) = U

CFDLean.dot.name: CFDLean.dot
CFDLean.dot.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Vector d → CFDLean.Vector d → ℝ

CFDLean.dot.eq_1.name: CFDLean.dot.eq_1
CFDLean.dot.eq_1.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (v S : CFDLean.Vector d), CFDLean.dot v S = ∑ i, v i * S i

CFDLean.dot_add.name: CFDLean.dot_add
CFDLean.dot_add.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (v S T : CFDLean.Vector d), (CFDLean.dot v fun i => S i + T i) = CFDLean.dot v S + CFDLean.dot v T

CFDLean.dot_mul.name: CFDLean.dot_mul
CFDLean.dot_mul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (v S : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : ℝ), (CFDLean.dot v fun i => a * S i) = a * CFDLean.dot v S

CFDLean.physicalFlux.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux
CFDLean.physicalFlux.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → CFDLean.Conservative d → CFDLean.Vector d → CFDLean.Conservative d

CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1
CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d),
  CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S =
    { density := CFDLean.dot U.momentum S,
      momentum := fun i =>
        U.momentum i * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * S i,
      energy := (U.energy + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) }

CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_add
CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S T : CFDLean.Vector d),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => S i + T i) =
    { density := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).density,
